title: Business Analyst
description:
**Overview**
 Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity
   

  

 With 4,300 employees and over 400,000 retail and institutional clients from more than 80 offices spread across five continents, we’re a Fortune\-100, Nasdaq\-listed provider, connecting clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world\-class products and services to all types of investors.
   

  

 Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, The StoneX Group is made up of four segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.
   

  

 Business Segment
   

  

**Payments** 
 : A Swift\-accredited service bureau and member, our Payments division provides NGOs, institutions and non\-profits the ability to make a local difference, globally – with transparent pricing across 180\+ countries and 140\+ currencies.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Position Purpose:** 
 The Business Analyst role in the StoneX Global Payments business is essential to ensure effective requirement management, structured backlog creation, and seamless product delivery aligned with the product owner’s vision. As StoneX undergoes a critical phase of consolidating internal applications and standardizing new platforms, the need for a strong BA function becomes even more important. The role serves as a key enabler in prioritizing product requirements, simplifying complex solutions, and ensuring the delivery of high\-quality, scalable products.
   

  

 Responsibilitie s – The Business Analyst will support the delivery of global payments solutions by gathering, analyzing, and translating business requirements into actionable stories. The role focuses on cross\-border payments processing, SWIFT messaging (MT/MX), and statement reconciliation , ensuring accurate, scalable, and compliant solutions
   

  

 Primary duties will include :
   

  

* Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements for payment and reconciliation systems
* Convert requirements into structured user stories with clear acceptance criteria
* Maintain and groom the product backlog aligned with product priorities
* Analyze and map SWIFT MT and ISO 20022 MX messages across systems
* Work with bank statements (MT940/950, CAMT.053\) and reconciliation logic
* Translating complex payment flows into clear functional solutions
* Support UAT, defect triage, and validation of MT/MX outputs
* This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all\-inclusive and can be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities that management deems necessary.


**Qualifications**
**To land this role you will need** 
 : Minimum Qualifications (Must Haves). List here the minimum things required to perform/get the job, candidates who don’t meet these will not be considered
   

  

 Strong understanding of:
   

  

* Strong understanding of Cross\-border payments and correspondent banking, Payment lifecycle and settlement concepts.
* SWIFT messaging: MT (MT103, MT202, MT9XX) and MX (ISO 20022 – PACS, CAMT)
* Payment lifecycle and settlement concepts
* Requirement gathering and documentation
* User story writing (preferably Agile/Scrum)
* Data analysis and mapping (good with Excel)
* APIs / file\-based integrations
* Strong communication and stakeholder management
* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving


**What makes you stand out:** 
 Nice to Haves. Candidates who meet these secondary qualifications will be considered suitable candidates. \- Best practice is to limit to 3\-5 bullet points
   

  

* Exposure to reconciliation processes , including transaction matching and break management
* Understanding of Auto Matching / Intelligent Matching (AI/ML\-based matching) concepts
* Rule\-based vs ML\-based matching approaches

title: Reporting and Visualization
description:
Join us as a Reporting and Visualization at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
   

  

 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with to oversee the financial aspects of trading activities as well as job\-specific skillset. To be successful as We deploy finance responsibly to support people and businesses, acting with empathy and integrity, championing innovation and sustainability, for the common good and the long term.
   

  

**To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:**
* Strong proficiency in all Microsoft Applications : advances excel/power point.
* Meticulous, strategic thinker with operational rigour and analytical/data driven mindset.
* High levels of self motivation, multi\-task and willingness to respectfully challenge status quo.
* Ability to articulate and present ideas both written presentations and orally to senior management.
* Strong command of data analytics, financial modelling, forecasting, and scenario planning.
* Interpreting complex data and translate into clear and actionable insights
* Professional, positive demeanour and a strong work ethic.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include Below**
* Experience in driving automation and transformation efforts.
* Collaborated, service oriented, and solutions oriented.
* Ability to deliver in fast paced environment with tight deadlines and handling multiple stakeholders/demands.
* Experience in Tableau/Power BI is an added advantage.


 This role will be based out of Pune office.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To support the bank's decision\-making processes by providing timely, accurate, and insightful information through designing, developing, and maintaining management reports, compelling visualisations and dashboards that effectively communicate key performance indicators (KPIs), data insights and trends across various business units.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Design and development of comprehensive reports and dashboards utilisng best practices in data visualisation principles and design aesthetics to ensure clarity, accuracy, and accessibility.
* Design, development and implementation of automated report generation processes and visualisation methodologies for improved efficiency and timeliness.
* Identification and analysis of business requirements to define report content and format.
* Maintenance and updating of existing reports and dashboards to reflect changing business needs, including co\-ordination of reporting template releases and related administrative tasks.
* Development of robust processes \& controls for collating input data, performing exploratory data analysis \& data cleansing and seeking signoffs as required.
* Engagement with stakeholders as needed to ensure up to date data is incorporated into reporting and visualisations.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Supply Chain Analyst 1
description:
**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
* Partner with global Trade Compliance and Operations teams to support adherence to international trade regulations
* Prepare, validate, and maintain documentation required for global trade compliance and shipment processing
* Contribute to audit readiness activities and support compliance monitoring efforts
* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to resolve trade\-related challenges effectively
* Develop certification documentation for approval by global trade leadership
* Engage with suppliers to assess eligibility and compliance with Free Trade Agreement (FTA) requirements
* Design and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and KPI reports using Power BI and Excel
* Deliver accurate and timely supply chain reports with a focus on on\-time delivery and error\-free outputs
* Analyze sourcing, purchasing, and supplier performance data to identify trends and improvement opportunities
* Generate insights on key metrics such as on\-time delivery, defects per million, spend, lead time, and cost savings
* Ensure data quality, integrity, and governance across systems and reporting platforms
* Build data models and automate reporting processes to enhance efficiency
* Integrate data from enterprise systems including ERP platforms
* Drive continuous improvement in analytics frameworks and reporting capabilities
* Support strategic planning initiatives by providing data\-driven insights to leadership


**Who You Are:**
 You take prompt and effective action in dynamic situations and adapt quickly to evolving priorities. You actively seek input from relevant stakeholders to make well\-informed, timely decisions. You encourage open dialogue and build collaborative relationships with diverse teams. You approach challenges with curiosity and use insights to drive meaningful improvements in processes and outcomes.
   

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* Experience working in supply chain analytics, trade compliance, operations, or procurement environments
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Power Query, Pivot Tables, Power Pivot, and VBA
* Hands\-on experience with Power BI for data visualization and reporting
* Knowledge of data modeling and DAX
* Experience working with SQL and understanding of ETL concepts
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving capabilities
* Ability to work collaboratively across global teams and manage multiple priorities


**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**
* Exposure to Python (e.g., Pandas, NumPy) for data analysis
* Familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle
* Experience with Power Apps and Power Automate
* Understanding of digital transformation initiatives in supply chain or manufacturing
* Experience working with advanced analytics tools or automation frameworks
* Awareness of Microsoft 365 Copilot capabilities in analytics workflows

title: Associate, RME
description:
**Job Description**
**Associate**
**Research, Monitoring \& Evaluation**
**September 2026 \| Pune**
**Background**
**About Centre For Learning Resources (CLR)**
 Centre for Learning Resources (CLR) is one of the oldest Indian non\-profit educational institutions of the Society for Educational Improvement and Innovation, based out of Pune, founded by India's veteran educator couple John Kurrien \& Zakiya Kurrien. We have been working in the domains of early childhood care and development (ECCD), Foundational literacy and numeracy (FLN) \& English as a second language (ESL) since 1984\. We have supported various government organisations and NGOs across the country in 9 states which include Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Uttarakhand, Odisha, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Andhra Pradesh, and Rajasthan. Offshore engagements have included Indonesia \& Nepal.
   

  

 CLR's vision is to assist in creating a more just and equitable society through the integrated development of children from marginalised communities, such that they grow up in child\-centred environments that nurture their holistic growth and learning. Our mission is to build large\-scale capacities of the ICDS systems, which are charged with this responsibility, so they can deliver effectively. This includes government machinery, civil society organisations, and NGOs.
   

  

 (For more information log onto http://www.clrindia.org/
   

  

**About the Role: Description \& Responsibilities**
 The M\&E Associates will work with the Program Managers and associates to ensure project goals are achieved. Additionally, they will collaborate with members across teams as and when required.
   

  

**The Key Responsibilities Are As Follows**
* Review project documents (ToC, LFA, etc.) to understand program delivery.
* Assist in designing, testing, and validating monitoring and evaluation (M\&E) tools.
* Support data management, ensuring accuracy and timely updates.
* Help develop and implement data collection plans and field assessments.
* Coordinate with program teams for consistent data collection across locations.
* Analyze data and prepare summaries, reports, and presentations.
* Participate in team meetings and contribute to strengthening M\&E systems.
* Travel to field sites, as needed, to support data collection activities.


**Requirement: Education \& Experience**
**Education \& Experience**
* Degree in education or related statistics/policy evaluation / social science/ social work/management discipline. Master’s degree preferred.
* Up to 2 Years of experience relevant to job responsibilities, after relevant minimum qualification


*Important: Given the nature of the project please apply only if you qualify based on the above requirements*

* Strong written and verbal communication skills; Proficiency in Marathi is an added advantage
* Proficient in MS Office, Google Suite, and presentation design.
* Familiarity with relevant data tools and platforms is an advantage
* Basic understanding of development and education programs in India.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently in semi\-structured settings.
* Ability to adapt to changing responsibilities and solve problems resourcefully.
* Patience, resilience, and a commitment to integrity, collaboration, and continuous learning.


**Location and Compensation**
**Location** 
 : Pune
   

  

**Compensation** 
 : Apart from being a part of a young and dynamic learning team, the individual will receive a healthy compensation at par with the non\-profit sector benchmark for this position, commensurate with the individual’s prior experience and qualifications. The current compensation band offered, based on fit and experience is
 **5\-6 Lakh INR per annum CTC** 
 based on the previous experience.
   

  

**Note:** 
 CLR is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind. We do not discriminate on the basis of caste, race, religion, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other non\-merit factor.
   

  

 We heartily welcome new members to join us and work closely with the experienced and diverse leadership team at CLR!
   

  

**Leadership Team**
**Chetan Bhangdia, Director**
 Chetan Bhangdia has extensive experience spanning more than 25 years in conceptualizing, building and delivering data and technology capabilities spanning strategy, programs, products, services, team set up and operations. He is an Engineer with a postgraduate degree in management. He takes care of program verticals, production, research, M\&E and all the organisational development functions at CLR.
   

  

**Anurata Tribhuvan, Head of Production \& Media and English Programs**
 Anurata comes with 18\+ years of experience in the field of production and media communication. She has a double Master's in Communication Media for Children from SNDT University and in Psychology from Pune University. Apart from being a CLR veteran, she has worked with SFM Radio, Star Pravah TV, ICC for Kids \& Natives Communications. Over the years, she has produced 800\+ modules in all formats of e\-learning content modules and video productions.
   

  

**Sufia Azmat, Head \- Early Childhood Programmes, Research \& Impact**
 Dr. Sufia Azmat has eighteen years of experience in Teaching, Curriculum Development, Research, and Policy Practice. After completing a Masters in Social Work from Aligarh Muslim University, she secured a Doctorate in Social Work and Child Care Practice from Jamia Millia Islamia. She has authored 10 papers on ECD concerns and participated in several international and national conferences. She has led 2 major projects funded by ICSSR and NHRC, and many minor projects. The thrust areas of her research and practice remain Early Childhood Development, Foundational Literacy and Numeracy, Maternal and Child Health, disaster and resilience, and Parenting using a Rights\-Based Approach.
   

  

**Kishore Jagtap, Head – Programme Operations**
 Kishorkumar Jagtap is Head – Programme Operations at CLR, with over 14 years of experience in the education sector with a strong foundation and passion for impactful change. He specializes in organization development, stakeholder management, and strategic planning and implementation of educational programs.
   

  

 Throughout his career, he has successfully led initiatives that drive institutional growth and improve program outcomes. His expertise lies in aligning educational strategies with organizational goals, ensuring sustainable and scalable development. Known for his collaborative approach, he builds strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to foster innovation and continuous improvement.He holds a Bachelor's degree in Engineering and brings a methodical, results\-driven mindset to every project he leads.

title: SUPV II SUPPLY CHAIN
description:
POSITION :
 *Supply Chain Analyst*
 JOB TITLE :
 *Supply Chain Analyst*
 Band level : 5\-3
   

  

 LOCATION : Pune
   

  

 BU : Global Automotive
   

  

 SEGMENT : Transportation Solutions (India)
   

  

**Company**
 TE Connectivity Ltd. is a $17\.26 billion global technology and manufacturing leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. For more than 75 years, our connectivity and sensor solutions, proven in the harshest environments, have enabled advancements in transportation, industrial applications, medical technology, energy, data communications, and the home. With 80,000 employees, including more than 7,500 engineers, working alongside customers in approximately 150 countries, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS.
   

  

**Bu / Function Description**
 Transportation Solutions BU makes products for Connecting and Sensing Data, Power and Signal for vehicles ranging from Two wheelers to Heavy Commercial trucks. There is a clear business strategy till 2025 to support the business growth. The growth is driven mainly driven from localization of Core India Specific products and also New technology products.
   

  

 ROLE OBJECTIVE
   

  

 To establish “Single source of Truth” by integrating and maintaining all Key performance metrics of SCM/CS LIVE through Tableau/Power BI
   

  

 To define the Capacity/Demand ratio for each part at each source location and make a trigger mechanism for new capacity
   

  

 To optimize the supply network by exploring opportunities to increase sea vs Air movement from Source country to India Warehouse and exploring clubbing opportunities at Source. Need to closely work with SCM team and Global Logistics team for integrated results.
   

  

 To continuously monitor the ageing stock (SCM) and ageing orders (CS)
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Capacity/Demand ratio:**
 Establish the C/D ratio of each part in each source plant and work with Planner for getting enhanced capacity as per demand. Also work with Demand team and Sales \& Marketing to get validated 24 months forecast
   

  

**Supply Network Optimization**
 To optimize the supply network by exploring opportunities to increase sea vs Air movement from Source country to India Warehouse and also exploring clubbing opportunities at Source. Need to closely work with SCM team and Global Logistics team for integrated results.
   

  

**Monitor Ageing Stock And Orders**
 To continuously monitor the ageing stock (SCM) and ageing orders (CS) and work with CS/SCM/sales \& marketing to liquidate those stocks/orders.
   

  

**Analytics**
 Work with application and product marketing and managing alternate part master.
   

  

**EDUCATION/KNOWLEDGE**
* MBA in Supply Chain
* Expertise in Excel
* Understanding of Tableau/Power BI
* Understanding in SAP IBP


**Critical Experience**
* 2 to 5 years of experience Handling large scale transformational SCM projects like SAP IBP/APO.
* Extensive exposure to Excel/Macros.
* Experience in Plant production planning.


**COMPETENCIES**
* SAP IBP \- Conduct the IBP execution starting from demand review, supply review and integrated reconciliation
* Strategic agility \- Long Term capacity planning.
* Supply network planning \- Supply Network optimization by choosing the right network (Factory \- SKU’s – Depot) based on the minimum total delivered cost (Freight Cost, Conversion Cost, Raw material cost and Tax benefit).
* Frequency from factory to warehouse).
* Ability to understand customer requirements.
* Stakeholder alignment \- Developing relationships and partnerships with key customers, industry leaders and core suppliers.


**MOTIVATIONAL/CULTURAL FIT**
* Problem solving
* Passion for work
* Results driven
* Clear and concise communication


**Job Overview**
 Supervises material inbound and outbound handling, warehousing, inventory management, goods transfer, loading, and unloading and ensures compliance with regulatory standards.
   

  

**Job Requirements**
* Leading inventory activities like vendor\-managed inventory and driving optimal stock level of raw materials.
* Implementing strategic projects related to supply chain optimization, footprint moves, and site deployment plans consistent with business unit/region strategic and operational planning.
* Supervising the material flow, managing the Sales and Operations Planning, the supply review process, and reporting summary to the management.
* Supporting the implementation and upgrade of advanced planning systems and monitoring the use of Lean tools.


**What Your Background Should Look Like**
 Generally requires Bachelors degree in appropriate field or local equivalent with a minimum of 3 years of progressively responsible professional level experience

title: SAP Signavio Architect/Techno-Functional Consultant
description:
Job Description: Technical SAP Signavio Architect/Tecno\-Functional Consultant
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 We are seeking a highly skilled SAP Signavio Tecno\-Functional Consultant with
 



 extensive hands\-on technical capabilities to lead end\-to\-end business process
 



 transformation, optimization, and process mining initiatives. Unlike traditional functional
 



 roles, this position demands a deep understanding of data architectures, systems
 



 integration, and hands\-on technical development.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business operations and technical data
 



 engineering, actively building data pipelines, profiling source data, setting up complex
 



 system integrations via SAP BTP, and writing advanced queries to power operational
 



 dashboards and process intelligence metrics.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Module\-Specific Functional Management
 



  SAP Signavio Process Manager: Establish and enforce workspace modeling
 



 conventions, govern the central corporate Dictionary for reusable business
 



 terms/objects, and model end\-to\-end process hierarchies using BPMN 2\.0 and
 



 DMN (Decision Model and Notation). Conduct process simulations and perform
 



 structured \"As\-Is\" vs. \"To\-Be\" diagram comparisons to evaluate impact.
 



  





  SAP Signavio Process Insights: Configure rapid connections to core SAP
 



 ERP/S/4HANA instances to gain immediate, automated visibility into business
 



 processes. Analyze standard out\-of\-the\-box performance indicators (such as
 



 automation rates, backlogs, and throughput), interpret industry benchmarking
 



 data, and execute standard correction or innovation recommendations.
 



  





  SAP Signavio Process Intelligence: Lead advanced process mining discovery
 



 initiatives across multi\-system environments. Execute detailed conformance
 



 checks to analyze actual execution against standard target models, and identify
 



 process execution leakage including compliance violations, unwanted loops, and
 



 manual workarounds.
 



  





 2\. Process Mining \& Data Profiling (Technical Hands\-on)
 



  Perform exhaustive data profiling and structural data analysis across SAP and
 



 non\-SAP source environments to validate data quality and completeness before
 



 process ingestion.
 



  





  Design, build, and maintain data ingestion pipelines for SAP Signavio Process
 



 Intelligence, mapping transactional data to event logs (Case ID, Activity,
 



 Timestamp).
 



  





  Identify data anomalies, concurrency issues, and gaps in transactional logs,
 



 implementing robust transformations to resolve them.
 



  





 3\. Integration \& SAP BTP Engineering
 



  Configure, establish, and optimize secure data connections between SAP
 



 Signavio and various backend applications (including third\-party ERPs, CRMs,
 



 legacy databases, and cloud services).
 



  





  Leverage SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) for enterprise integration,
 



 data orchestration, data federation, and custom extension developments.
 



  





  Implement API\-based integrations and utilize JDBC/ODBC connectors, secure
 



 file transfers, and cloud ingestion agents to capture real\-time or batch
 



 transactional records.
 



  





 4\. Query Development \& Analytics
 



  Write, debug, and optimize complex queries using SIGNAL (Signavio Process
 



 Mining Query Language) and standard SQL to extract process insights and
 



 calculate critical KPIs.
 



  





  Develop advanced process dashboards, custom metrics, and automated alerts
 



 within SAP Signavio Process Intelligence to expose process bottlenecks,
 



 variations, and compliance violations.
 



  





  Build predictive metrics and custom logic to track process behavior and trigger
 



 operational actions based on data patterns.
 



  





 5\. Process Modeling \& Functional Analysis
 



  Lead collaborative process discovery workshops with business stakeholders to
 



 model \"As\-Is\" and \"To\-Be\" business processes using BPMN 2\.0 standards within SAP Signavio Process Manager.
 



  





  Translate analytical findings from process mining into actionable business
 



 optimization strategies, collaborating with functional process owners.
 



  





  Align custom developments with standard SAP Best Practices and Signavio
 



 Value Accelerators to accelerate digital transformation milestones (e.g., SAP
 



 S/4HANA migrations).
 



  





 Required Technical \& Functional Qualifications
 



  





  Experience: Minimum of 5 to 10 years of professional experience in Business
 



 Process Management (BPM) and Process Mining, with at least 5 years of direct,
 



 hands\-on technical implementation experience using the SAP Signavio Suite.
 



  





  Functional Competencies:
 



 o Extensive knowledge of Process Manager, including business
 



 architecture design, simulation setups, and DMN decision tables.
 



 o Deep proficiency in Process Insights, including setting up automated
 



 data extractions, analyzing standard process flows, tracking master data
 



 categories, and navigating the Variant Explorer.
 



 o Masterful command of Process Intelligence functional configurations,
 



 identifying root causes, managing metrics, and aligning data\-driven
 



 findings with stakeholders.
 



  





  Signavio Toolset Mastery: Proven expertise across SAP Signavio Process
 



 Intelligence (specifically the ETL layer), Process Manager, and Collaboration
 



 Hub.
 



  





  Database \& Query Skills: Exceptional proficiency in writing complex queries in
 



 standard SQL and SIGNAL. Deep understanding of relational database
 



 management systems (RDBMS), data warehousing concepts, and schema
 



 design.
 



  





  SAP BTP \& Middleware: Practical, hands\-on experience using SAP BTP for
 



 data integration, orchestration, or application deployment. Familiarity with SAP
 



 Integration Suite (Cloud Integration) is highly advantageous.
 



  





  Third\-Party Integrations: Demonstrated track record connecting Signavio to
 



 non\-SAP systems (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, or custom legacy
 



 databases) via REST/SOAP APIs and standard database connectors.
 



  





  Data Engineering: Experience in ETL/ELT development, data profiling tools,
 



 data cleansing methodology, and transforming raw transactional tables into event
 



 logs.
 



  





 Preferred Professional Qualifications
 



  





  Preferred \- Official certification in SAP Signavio
 



  





  Prior functional experience in core enterprise process cycles such as Order\-to\-
 



 Cash (O2C), Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), or Record\-to\-Report (R2R).
 



  





  Experience assisting organizations through large\-scale migrations from SAP
 



 ECC to SAP S/4HANA using process mining insights.
 



  





 Core Soft Skills
 



  





  Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset capable of drilling down into low\-
 



 level data anomalies while maintaining a high\-level operational perspective.
 



  





  Excellent communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to translate
 



 complex technical data structures into clear business insights for executive
 



 stakeholders.
 



  





  Comfortable working in agile, fast\-paced environments with cross\-functional
 



 global teams.
 



  





  





 Please share your CV at hr@mindamend.net

title: PC Equities Analyst
description:

At Barclays, we believe in the power of innovation. Your role will be responsible for monitoring trading activity for compliance with various related policies and providing management with technical and operational analysis of the business unit. You will have the opportunity of working closely with Front Office business, Financial Control, Technical Accounting Group, PC Change Management, Technology, and other infrastructure area. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future \- we're creating it.

* Experienced with MS office toolkit.
* Qualified accountant.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills in both formal and informal settings \& ability to interact with the region and UK / US as part of a global team (written and verbal).
* Strong control awareness – in particular, the ability to identify and escalate potential control breakdowns and to streamline processes in an effective and efficient manner.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include Below**
* Article ship / Industrial trainee in mid to large sized firms.
* Audit exposure in large financial institutions / banks preferred.

 This role is based in our Chennai / Pune office.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To oversee the financial aspects of trading activities, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the bank's trading book, maintenance of compliance with regulatory requirements, and provision of insights into trading performance.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Reconciliation of daily profit and loss (P\&L) figures for trading desks to ensure they align with the valued positions in the trading book, investigating and resolving discrepancies between P\&L figures to ensure they reflect the true economic value of the trading portfolio.
* Support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of trading risks, and report on these financial risks to senior colleagues.
* Maintenance and analysis of the bank’s trading data, ensuring its accuracy, completeness and consistency, and provision of insights to traders and senior colleagues on trading performance.
* Preparation and submission of regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to external audits including addressing auditor queries and ensuring trading activities are appropriately reflected in financial statements.
* Effective communication of complex financial information to traders, risk professionals, senior colleagues, and external stakeholders.
* Cross functional collaboration to ensure a coordinated approach to trading activities.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Data Architect
description:

 The Data Architect \& Data Manager is responsible for defining and governing the end\-to\-end data architecture, data management practices, and business intelligence roadmap for the Logistics Data Domain. This role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders, data engineering teams, analytics professionals, and senior leadership, ensuring that data solutions align with strategic business objectives while adhering to enterprise data governance standards.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Design, maintain, and evolve scalable data architectures and data pipelines in Snowflake, applying proven relational database design principles and modern cloud data platform best practices.
* Define standards for data modeling, integration, transformation, storage, and consumption across logistics data products.
* Review and approve architectural designs, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and data governance standards.
* Guide and mentor Data Engineers in implementing architecture solutions, ensuring compliance with coding standards, performance optimization practices, and data quality requirements.
* Monitor implementation progress and provide technical leadership throughout the development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, Data Analysts, and Visualization Engineers to gather and refine reporting and analytics requirements.
* Evaluate business intelligence requests based on strategic value, business impact, effort, and data readiness.
* Establish and maintain a prioritized analytics backlog and delivery roadmap.
* Resolve conflicts between tactical reporting demands and strategic data initiatives by ensuring alignment with long\-term business objectives.
* Promote reusable data products and self\-service analytics capabilities across the logistics organization.
* Ensure compliance with Data Governance standards, processes, policies, and controls.
* Define and monitor data quality improvement initiatives and remediation plans.
* Establish governance processes to ensure data remains fit for purpose, trusted, and available to support business operations and decision\-making.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go\-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
   

  

 Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands\-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer\-first approach. It also mentors less\-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long\-term maintainability before go\-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source\-to\-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit\-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data.
* Confirm and pressure\-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design.
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go\-live.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision\-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross\-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid\-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth.
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery.
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap.


**Requirements And Preferred Experience**
* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5\+ years of hands\-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3\+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data\-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI\-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data\-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less\-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer\-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field


**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
 At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
   

  

**Opportunity to Innovate**
 The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
   

  

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
 This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
   

  

**A Place to Make Your Mark**
 We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
   

  

**Benefits That Work For You**
 Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
   

  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

 Manufacturing Knowledge \- Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

 Procurement Systems \- Recognizes linkage to multiple systems such as purchasing order, payment, engineering release, and quality systems; troubleshoots and corrects issues resulting from data issues; writes ad\-hoc reports using tools within each application; identifies and documents work flows and system testing; actively participates in implementation process of new purchasing systems including requirements gathering, design, communication, and training.

 This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

title: Sr. Amazon Ads Executive
description:

**Role Description** 
 The Sr. Amazon Ads Executive is a full\-time, on\-site position based in the Pune Division. Day\-to\-day tasks include managing sponsored ads and other Amazon ad formats, conducting keyword and competitor research, monitoring campaign performance, and preparing regular reports and insights for internal teams and clients. title: Senior Data Analyst, Network Analytics & AI
description:
We are hiring a Senior Data Analyst to turn 5G/LTE network telemetry, crash data and operational metrics into insights that improve network reliability and customer experience.
   

  

 You' will own analytics from raw data to executive dashboards, and work closely with engineering, product and customer operations.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience, 5\+ years in data analytics, including at least 2 in a senior or lead role.
* Strong SQL and Python (pandas, NumPy); comfortable with large, high\-volume datasets.
* Solid grasp of statistics, time\-series analysis and anomaly detection.
* Hands\-on experience with ML libraries such as scikit\-learn, XGBoost or statsmodels.
* Practical knowledge of time\-series forecasting (Prophet, ARIMA or similar) and unsupervised anomaly detection (Isolation Forest, clustering).
* Understanding of model evaluation, feature engineering and how to avoid common problems like data leakage and class imbalance.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with the ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) and Kafka.
* Telecom domain knowledge (RAN, 4G/5G KPIs, O\-RAN).
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, cloud platforms (AWS) or data engineering workflows.
* Experience applying LLMs or GenAI (prompting, retrieval\-augmented generation, LLM APIs) to analytics or operations use cases.
* Familiarity with deep learning (PyTorch or TensorFlow) for sequence or log data.
* Exposure to MLOps basics: model versioning, monitoring and drift detection.
* Experience with Elasticsearch ML features or AIOps platforms.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyse large telemetry and event datasets (KPIs, alarms, downtime, crash reports) to find trends, anomalies and root causes.
* Build and validate ML models for anomaly detection, KPI forecasting, crash clustering and root\-cause classification on network telemetry.
* Use AI and LLM tools to speed up analysis, such as summarising logs and crash reports, natural\-language querying and automated insight generation.
* Work with engineering to move validated models from notebooks into production pipelines and dashboards.
* Define KPIs, metrics and data models with product and engineering teams.
* Write efficient queries and aggregations on Elasticsearch, SQL and Python\-based pipelines.
* Leverage AI tools throughout the SDLC — from design and coding to testing, documentation, and troubleshooting — to accelerate delivery while ensuring output is reviewed, validated, and production\-ready.

 Build and maintain the dashboards leadership uses weekly, covering revenue, pipeline, production, app performance and marketing spend.

 Prepare data and analysis for investor, board and partner materials.
 



 Required Qualifications
 



 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science or a related field.
 



 2 to 4 years of hands\-on analytics experience with ownership of the output, not just the query.
 



 Strong SQL. Comfortable writing and optimising queries without assistance.
 



 Working knowledge of Python or R for analysis and automation.
 



 Fluency in at least one BI tool: Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio or Metabase.
 



 Advanced Excel, including pivots, lookups and modelling.
 



 Familiarity with product analytics such as GA4, Firebase, Mixpanel or Amplitude.
 



 The ability to explain a finding to someone non\-technical, in one paragraph, without a chart.
 



 Curiosity about the business. The best analysis here comes from asking why a number moved before being asked.
 



**Nice to Have** 




 Experience in hardware, manufacturing or consumer apps.
 



 dbt or a modern data stack.
 



 Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking.
 



 Basic statistics and experiment design.
 



 Why QWR
 



 Own the numbers end to end rather than servicing someone else's dashboard.
 



 Rare breadth. Hardware production data, consumer app behaviour and B2B pipeline in one role.
 



 Your work goes to the founder weekly, with no layer in between.

 CV screening, a call with the hiring manager, then a short practical exercise on a real dataset and a discussion of your approach. We share feedback within 48 hours of every stage.

 Apply here on LinkedIn, or send your CV to hr@questionwhatsreal.com quoting the role title in the subject line. If you have dashboards or analyses you are proud of, include them or describe them.

The role requires advanced SQL and Python expertise, strong knowledge of data architecture and ETL frameworks, and hands\-on experience with Amazon Redshift. title: Senior Associates – Balance Sheet and Control CoE
description:
**Job Description**

 The Senior Accounting Control Associate is responsible for driving the organization's financial governance and control framework through the execution, oversight and continuous enhancement of key accounting controls. This role provides advanced support across balance sheet reconciliations, ASC 606 revenue recognition compliance, journal entry governance, SOX controls, audit readiness, and financial close processes.
   

  





 The role requires strong analytical capabilities, the ability to independently manage complex accounting control activities, identify and mitigate financial risks and partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to strengthen the overall control environment. The Senior Associate is also expected to lead process improvement initiatives, mentor junior team members and support management in ensuring compliance with accounting standards, internal policies and regulatory requirements.
   

  





  

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  





 1\. Balance Sheet Reconciliations \& Account Governance
   

  




* Lead the preparation and review of complex balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely completion.


* Perform detailed analysis of high\-risk and critical accounts, identifying trends, anomalies, and potential control concerns.


* Drive resolution of aged reconciling items and collaborate with business stakeholders to remediate issues.


* Monitor compliance with reconciliation policies, governance standards, and control requirements.


* Support management reviews and provide insights on account integrity and financial risk exposure.


* Coach and guide team members on reconciliation best practices and quality standards.



 2\. Revenue Recognition Controls (ASC 606\)
   

  




* Execute and oversee revenue recognition control activities in compliance with ASC 606 and company policies.


* Review complex revenue transactions and supporting documentation to ensure accurate accounting treatment.


* Assess and investigate revenue\-related risks, exceptions and control gaps, driving timely remediation.


* Partner with Revenue Assurance, Finance, Commercial, and Controllership teams to ensure compliance and operational effectiveness.


* Support implementation of new revenue recognition requirements, process changes, and control enhancements.


* Provide subject matter expertise on revenue control matters and assist with issue resolution.



 3\. Journal Entry Governance \& Financial Close
   

  




* Review and approve journal entries for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with accounting policies.


* Coordinate and support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close activities to ensure timely reporting.


* Monitor close performance metrics and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and quality.


* Ensure appropriate documentation, review evidence and control execution are maintained throughout the close cycle.


* Support resolution of complex accounting issues impacting financial reporting and close processes.


* Assist management in driving a robust financial close governance framework.



 4\. SOX Compliance, IPE \& Audit Management
   

  




* Execute and oversee SOX controls and Information Produced by the Entity (IPE) validation procedures.


* Maintain audit\-ready documentation and ensure control evidence meets internal and external audit requirements.


* Coordinate responses to audit requests and support walkthroughs, testing and remediation activities.


* Identify control deficiencies, recommend corrective actions and track remediation to closure.


* Partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, Compliance and Controllership teams to strengthen governance practices.


* Contribute to risk assessments and the continuous enhancement of the control environment.



 5\. Reporting, Analytics \& Continuous Improvement
   

  




* Develop and enhance control dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting to support governance oversight.


* Perform trend analysis and identify emerging risks, control exceptions and improvement opportunities.


* Lead automation and process optimization initiatives utilizing technology and reporting tools.


* Drive standardization of processes, documentation and control execution across operating units.


* Support implementation of best practices related to controllership, compliance and financial governance.


* Recommend and implement improvements that enhance efficiency, control effectiveness, and reporting quality.



 6\. Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
   

  




* Serve as a key point of contact for finance, controllership, audit, and business stakeholders.


* Provide guidance, coaching, and knowledge sharing to junior associates and new team members.


* Lead small projects and improvement initiatives with minimal supervision.


* Support managers in strategic controllership and governance programs.


* Promote a culture of accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
* Master’s or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.


* 5\-8 years of experience in accounting, controllership, financial controls, audit, SOX compliance, or financial governance functions.


* Strong knowledge of US GAAP, ASC 606 revenue recognition requirements and SOX compliance frameworks.


* Proven experience supporting month\-end close, balance sheet reconciliations, and financial reporting processes.


* Experience working with internal and external auditors in a regulated environment.


* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and risk assessment capabilities.


* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


* Ability to manage multiple priorities, influence outcomes, and deliver under tight deadlines.


* Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.



  

  





 Preferred Skills \& Experience
   

  




* Experience working in a multinational, publicly traded, or SOX\-regulated organization.


* Advanced experience with:


* OneStream (Account Reconciliations and Controls)


* SAP (General Ledger, Journal Entries, Financial Reporting)

* Knowledge of emerging technologies and automation solutions in finance and controllership functions.


**Additional Information**

title: Breach Management
description:
Join us as an
 **Employee Breach \& Conduct Rules** 
 professional, responsible for supporting the Head of Employee Breach \& Conduct Rules in delivering activities aligned to the Compliance Investigations \& Insights strategic book of work.
   

  

 The Team acts as the firm's centre of excellence for employee conduct risk, providing expert advice, behavioural insights, and strategic guidance on employee conduct matters. The team supports Control Functions and business leaders in interpreting, escalating, and remediating conduct issues, and drives continuous improvement in the firm's conduct culture.
   

  

 The role holder will provide delivery, oversight and check and challenge on business and compliance matters to evidence that the organisation is operating in compliance with Barclays legal, regulatory and ethical responsibilities.
   

  

 To be successful as an Employee Breach \& Conduct Rules professional, you should have:
   

  

  

* Understanding of the Conduct Risk Framework.
* Ability to multitask and manage projects while completing daily tasks and responsibilities.
* Must have an execution mindset and an understanding of the role compliance plays in Employee Conduct.
* Attention to detail, strong analytical skills and a diligent approach to understanding and confirming facts.
* Ability to consistently demonstrate sound judgement and confident, risk\-based decision making.
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, being able to communicate confidently and effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels, both verbally and in writing.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Ability to engage, organise, and support stakeholder meetings in order to establish and influence outcomes.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously with accuracy and professionalism, in a fast paced environment.
* Sound judgement together with strong communication, influencing and interpersonal skills to work with and support others effectively, driving behavioural change.
* Curious mindset, ability to work accurately and at pace with team members and stakeholders.
* Confident and excellent communication skills.
* Strong influencer.
* Reliable, dependable, accountable.
* Strong Team Player.
* Ambitious, intelligent and hard working individual.


 Critical Skills Statement
   

  

 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as:
   

  

  

* Assess sensitive conduct cases and escalation decisions, ensuring proportionality and consistency in behavioural assessments.
* Interpret behavioural trends and provide recommendations to reduce conduct risk and enhance the conduct culture.
* Support consistency in the application of conduct standards across the organisation by providing subject matter expertise to Policy Reinforcers, Employee Relations, and other stakeholders.
* Manage and influence a range of stakeholders.
* Work closely with cross function Operational Leads to support in activities such as the documentation of process and procedures, optimisation and data Governance.
* Support the transformation of Global Breach Management along with the existing Conduct Rules framework to achieve the right outcomes.


**This role is based in Pune.**
**Purpose of the role**
 To investigate employee conduct exceptions, provide oversight \& advice and mitigate compliance risks. Help maintain a culture of employee integrity and compliance within the organisation through delivery of appropriate training and execution of controls.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and implementation of policies related to employee conduct that aligns with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
* Implementation of surveillance and monitoring systems to track and report on employee behaviour.
* Development of training programmes to educate employees on conduct expectations, ethical standards, and regulatory obligations.
* Completion of task and exceptions from the following areas Breach Management \& Reward, Global Registrations (including the UK Senior Managers Regime), Conduct Rules, Mandatory Block Leave and Personal Investments \& Affiliations to ensure oversight of relevant Employee Conduct policy and standards.
* Development and implementation of controls related to employee conduct that aligns with regulatory requirements and Barclays’ risk appetite and industry best practices.
* Provision of advice and assistance across Barclays on matters that relating to employee conduct.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:

**Title And Summary**

 Job Posting Title: Lead, Big Data Analytics \& Engineering
   

  

 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

**About Mastercard**
 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere—by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Through secure data, trusted networks, partnerships, and innovation, we enable individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses to realise their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our culture is defined by our Decency Quotient (DQ), guiding how we work, collaborate, and create impact—inside and outside our company. With a presence across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Lead, Big Data Analytics \& Engineering role is a senior technical leadership position focused on data engineering, data unification, and large scale analytics enablement across enterprise data assets.
   

  

 This role plays a critical part in building a single, trusted, and scalable view of data by integrating diverse internal and external data sources. The position directly supports the delivery of data driven products, platforms, and insights, particularly in the areas of Value Quantification, Cyber Intelligence, and Analytics led solutions.
   

  

 As a technical lead, you will combine hands on engineering leadership with strong cross functional collaboration, partnering closely with Product Management, Data Science, Platform Strategy, and Technology teams to design and deliver high impact data solutions that generate measurable business value.
   

  

 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Data Engineering \& Platform Leadership
   

  

* Lead the ingestion, transformation, aggregation, and processing of large scale datasets to enable advanced analytics and downstream consumption.
* Design, build, and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines across Hadoop and enterprise data platforms, ensuring high standards of data quality, reliability, performance, and availability.
* Drive data unification initiatives, integrating multiple structured and semi structured data sources into a cohesive, governed analytical foundation.


 Advanced Analytics Enablement
   

  

* Manipulate and analyse high volume, high velocity, and high dimensional datasets using modern big data frameworks.
* Analyse large volumes of transactional and product data to produce insights and actionable recommendations that support business growth and value realisation.
* Apply metrics, measurement frameworks, and benchmarking techniques to evaluate solution effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.


 Cross Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Partner with Product Managers, Data Science, Platform Strategy, and Technology teams to understand analytical and data requirements and translate them into scalable engineering solutions.
* Act as a technical bridge between business, analytical, and engineering teams, clearly articulating architecture decisions, trade offs, and implementation approaches.
* Enable alignment across stakeholders to ensure data solutions are directly tied to business and customer outcomes.


 Innovation \& Value Creation
   

  

* Identify innovation opportunities and deliver proofs of concept, prototypes, and pilot solutions aligned to near term and future business needs.
* Integrate new and emerging data assets that enhance existing platforms, products, and services, strengthening overall value propositions.
* Gather and synthesise feedback from clients, product, engineering, and sales teams to inform new solutions and product enhancements.


 Technical Leadership \& Mentorship
   

  

* Provide technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to data engineers and analysts, setting standards for engineering quality, scalability, performance, and maintainability.
* Promote best practices in data modelling, pipeline design, performance optimisation, and data governance.
* Influence engineering standards, architectural consistency, and long term platform sustainability.


 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

**All About You**
 Technical Skills \& Experience
   

  

* Strong proficiency in Python, including Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, with hands on experience using Impala.
* Proven experience working on Hadoop based platforms, performing large scale data extraction, transformation, and processing.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with both relational and distributed data stores.
* Experience with enterprise data platforms and business intelligence ecosystems.
* Hands on experience with ETL / ELT and data integration tools, such as Apache Airflow, Apache NiFi, Azure Data Factory, Pentaho, or Talend.
* Experience in data modelling, querying, data mining, and reporting over large volumes of granular data.
* Exposure to machine learning concepts and analytical techniques used in advanced data solutions.
* Experience with Graph Databases is a plus.
* 8\+ years of experience in data engineering, big data analytics, or enterprise data platforms, including 2\+ years in a lead or technical leadership role.
* Experience working with cloud based data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including data lakes, distributed compute, and storage services.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices for data engineering workflows.


**GenAI / LLM Skills (Preferred)**
* Experience enabling GenAI/AI products through scalable, reliable data ingestion and transformation pipelines (batch and streaming).
* Exposure to unstructured and semi\-structured data processing (documents/logs/text) and building curated datasets for downstream consumption.
* Strong understanding of data governance, privacy, and security requirements when using enterprise data with AI (PII handling, access control, auditability).
* Familiarity with operationalizing AI data workflows (monitoring, data quality checks, reproducibility, and cost\-aware scaling in cloud environments).


 Analytical \& Business Acumen
   

  

* Strong experience collecting, standardising, and summarising diverse datasets while identifying patterns, inconsistencies, and data quality issues.
* Solid understanding of how analytics, metrics, and visualisation support business decision making.
* Ability to comprehend complex operational systems and deliver scalable analytics and information products to a global user base.


 Ways of Working
   

  

* Comfortable operating in a fast paced, delivery driven environment, both as a hands on contributor and a technical leader.
* Ability to move seamlessly between business, analytical, and technical contexts, communicating clearly with diverse audiences.
* Demonstrates Mastercard’s DQ values, with a collaborative, inclusive, and customer centric mindset.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
