title: Digital Customer Insights & Renewal Intelligence Specialist
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
   

  

**The Role**
 Digital Customer Success provides structured, scalable Customer Success engagement for customers outside dedicated one\-to\-one coverage. The function combines customer intelligence, proactive risk identification, digital engagement, and cross\-functional coordination to help customers realize value and enable account teams to take timely, informed action.
   

  

 You will own the account\-intelligence and renewal\-risk workstream, converting multi\-source customer data into repeatable health reviews, early\-warning insights, portfolio reporting, and actionable Customer Success narratives. The role combines hands\-on analysis with process ownership, data quality, stakeholder coordination, and automation readiness.
   

  

**Your Impact**
**Account health reviews:** 
 Build standardised reviews that combine renewal timing, product usage, entitlement, support activity, training, certification, version adoption and customer sentiment into clear strengths, risks and recommended actions.
   

  

**Early\-warning and risk analysis:** 
 Maintain risk inputs, logic, thresholds and tiering; validate outputs and distinguish genuine customer risk from data gaps.
   

  

**Portfolio and segmentation:** 
 Maintain priority account cohorts using approved segmentation rules, renewal timing, risk triggers and stakeholder inputs.
   

  

**Renewal intelligence:** 
 Track renewal cohorts, surface concerns early and prepare account\-level inputs for regional renewal reviews.
   

  

**Risk and leadership reporting:** 
 Produce concise account and portfolio reporting with evidence, data\-quality caveats and recommended follow\-up.
   

  

**CRM health narratives:** 
 Draft and maintain clear health, risk and next\-step entries aligned to the review cadence.
   

  

**Data and source management:** 
 Extract, reconcile and quality\-check information from CRM, BI, usage, support, training, version and survey sources.
   

  

**Cross\-functional collaboration:** 
 Work with account teams, Customer Success Operations and technical data owners to validate context and recommendations.
   

  

**Documentation and controls:** 
 Maintain source links, definitions, standard operating procedures, quality checks, templates and cadence calendars.
   

  

**Automation and enablement:** 
 Help translate review and risk\-reporting processes into scalable workflows while preserving quality and traceability.
   

  

 What You'll Need
   

  

**Experience:** 
 3–5 years in Customer Success operations, customer\-health or renewal analytics, business analytics, data analytics or comparable work.
   

  

**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Analytics, Business, Information Systems or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
   

  

**Data capability:** 
 Advanced Excel skills and demonstrated experience handling and reconciling multiple data sources.
   

  

**Reporting tools:** 
 Hands\-on experience with a business intelligence tool such as Power BI and experience working with CRM data.
   

  

**Business judgement:** 
 Working understanding of customer health, adoption, churn or attrition risk, renewals and Customer Success operating models.
   

  

**Communication:** 
 Ability to convert complex evidence into concise, defensible narratives and practical recommendations for business stakeholders.
   

  

**Operating discipline:** 
 High attention to detail, source traceability, documentation quality and recurring delivery commitments.
   

  

**Preferred / Nice To Have**
**Customer Success platforms:** 
 Experience with Gainsight or a comparable platform.
   

  

**Data and automation:** 
 Exposure to Snowflake or other data\-warehouse extracts, Power Query, SQL, scripting or workflow automation.
   

  

**Relevant models:** 
 Experience developing health scores, early\-warning models, renewal dashboards or executive account reviews.
   

  

**Industry context:** 
 Experience in B2B enterprise software or industrial software.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

**Reliable delivery:** 
 Account reviews, risk refreshes, reports and CRM narratives are accurate and completed against an agreed operating calendar.
   

  

**Actionable insight:** 
 Account teams can understand the evidence, validate the context and act on the recommendations.
   

  

**Data integrity:** 
 Material data gaps are visible and tracked rather than being misclassified as customer risk.
   

  

**Scalability:** 
 Processes and controls are documented and progressively standardised or automated without reducing quality.
   

  

 How This Role Works
   

  

 This role supports customers and internal stakeholders across multiple regions and requires effective collaboration in a globally distributed environment. The role enables account teams with structured insights or scaled engagement and does not replace commercial account ownership.

title: Data & Integration Analyst
description:

 We need a data enthusiast who pairs sharp analytical capabilities with the leverage of modern AI tools. As our organization harmonizes multiple disparate systems, data sources, and analytics platforms into a single operational home, this role will lead and orchestrate the collection, cohesion, and maintenance of our core data models (unified accounts, contacts, candidates, deals, activity, and work records).
 





 You will design and oversee the foundational data layer that allows future AI agents to read seamlessly across all entity data without an integration tax, setting the groundwork for our incoming ERP consolidation.

* ****Canonical Data Model:****

 Define entity structures, relationships, and identity\-resolution logic across accounts, contacts, candidates, deals, projects, and work records.
* ****Validation at Ingest:****

 Establish upfront validation rules that prevent low\-quality records from entering systems, shifting focus from post\-hoc error reporting to preventative data hygiene.
* ****Integration Layer Coordination:****

 Collaborate with full\-stack engineers to maintain an adaptable integration layer, ensuring vendor replacements require simple configuration rather than a full code rewrite.
* ****Reporting \& Dashboards Foundation:****

 Build and govern the modeled semantic layer beneath our Power BI transition, unifying legacy reports and setting up actionable dashboards for the future ERP.
* ****Agent Data Access:****

 Architect clean, permissioned, and documented read paths so internal AI agents consume structured data directly rather than scraping front\-end source systems.
* ****Data Quality Ownership:****

 Serve as the direct point of contact and owner for recurring systemic data defects.
* ****Migration Strategy:****

 Lead data migration paths off retired legacy systems while preserving historical continuity and audit trails.
* ****Lean AI \& Continuous Improvement:****

 Apply Lean principles and AI tools to reduce data failure points, detect early warning indicators, and define KPIs/SLAs to optimize organizational performance.
* ****Unstructured Data Insights:****

 Monitor, analyze, and process speech, text, and sentiment analysis inputs across business channels.



  





****Requirements****



* ****4\+ years****

 of hands\-on experience in data and analytics, featuring heavy data\-modeling responsibilities.
* Proven track record of designing a canonical data model across multiple source systems, with the ability to articulate trade\-offs in identity resolution and deduplication.
* Deep knowledge of
 
****PostgreSQL****

 (schema design, normalization trade\-offs, database migrations, query performance tuning).
* ****SQL proficiency****

 for data exploration, auditing, reconciliation, and cross\-database validation.
* ****Python expertise****

 for developing transformation scripts and data pipelines.
* Demonstrated experience building and supporting integrations with commercial SaaS APIs (handling rate limits, unexpected schema updates, and partial failures).
* Strong understanding of data\-layer security, designing models where authorization and field\-level restrictions are enforced structurally.
* Proactive adoption of AI tools to accelerate pipeline creation, audit data quality, and enrich datasets.
* Inherent curiosity and rigor for inspecting, validating, and establishing trust in business metrics.



  





****Strong Preferences****



* Direct familiarity with core enterprise data models across
 
****ERP, HRIS, WFM, or CRM platforms****

 (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Genesys, Oracle, or Aspect).
* Experience using tools like
 
****dbt****

 (or comparable transformation and automated testing frameworks).
* Hands\-on experience working with
 
****Tableau, Power BI****

 , or similar analytics stacks, specifically using AI to extract insight from structured datasets.
* Practical experience consolidating legacy commercial systems onto unified or in\-house platforms.
* Exposure to recruitment, workforce, or operations data, including handling
 
****candidate PII and data retention****

 requirements.

title: Distribution Revenue Analyst - Hotels
description:
Location: Yerwada, Pune
 



 Full\-Time Job: Work from office
 



 Work Hours: US Business Hours (4 PM to 2 AM IST)
 



 Experience: 2 to 4 years in hotel revenue management, pricing or travel analytics
 



  





**About Atica:** 




 Atica is a leading, tech\-first remote sales \& revenue management company for Hotels and Hotel operators in the US, enabled by a unified tech\-led solution. We are a startup, funded by the top investors in the country, like Titan Capital, DIBS. As innovators at the forefront of the industry, we strive to deliver the highest quality service to all our clients while setting new standards for efficiency and effectiveness.  https://www.aticaglobal.com
 



 https://www.linkedin.com/company/atica\-global
 



  





**The opportunity** 




 Our hotels sell through global wholesalers, bedbanks, OTAs and corporate channels. Each channel has its own rate structure and contract terms. Correct numbers decide if a channel makes money for the hotel.
 



 In this role, you own these numbers. Your analysis tells the team which rate to offer, which channel to grow and which problem to fix first. You work directly with the Director of Distribution and with our Revenue Managers

* Experience with Git, pull requests, CI/CD, Docker, Terraform/CloudFormation, automated testing, observability, and incident response

* Perform deep dive analysis on enrollment files and transactions to resolve data discrepancies such as missing coverage details incorrect effective dates and plan mapping errors that affect payer and provider partners.

* Support user acceptance testing for enrollment and eligibility functions by creating test conditions organizing test data and validating outcomes against business rules and HIPAA guidelines.
* Prepare clear business requirement documents functional specifications and change impact assessments that communicate enrollment impacts to operations technology compliance and client facing teams.
* Engage with stakeholders during night shift meetings to review requirements clarify open questions and align on scope changes while maintaining a professional and inclusive communication style.
* Monitor key performance indicators related to enrollment accuracy turnaround time and rejection rates and propose data driven improvements that enhance service quality for members providers and payer partners.

* Support incident analysis and root cause investigations for enrollment related production issues by reviewing logs configuration and data to recommend sustainable corrective actions that prevent recurrence.

* Assist in preparing training content and reference guides for operations staff on updated enrollment procedures plan structures and exception handling to promote consistent night shift execution.
* Participate in continuous improvement efforts by proposing automation opportunities for enrollment validations reconciliations and notifications that reduce manual effort and error risk across payer and provider operations.

* Apply working knowledge of HIPAA requirements to design and review processes that safeguard member data during eligibility updates enrollment changes and transmission of enrollment files.
* Utilize solid skills in requirements elicitation process mapping and documentation tools to produce artifacts that are easy for both technical and operations teams to understand and implement.
* Show proficiency in analyzing data using spreadsheets reporting tools or similar applications to validate enrollment outcomes identify trends in error patterns and recommend corrective measures.
* Communicate effectively in spoken and written form with stakeholders across product operations technology and compliance teams while working within a hybrid and night shift environment.
* Adapt to changing client needs and regulatory updates in the healthcare payer and provider landscape while maintaining high quality standards and timely delivery of analysis outcomes.

title: AVP, Collections Specialized Strategy (L10)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Collections Specialized Strategy (L10\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 This role will be responsible for Collections Strategy analytics to generate insights in strategy development, implementation, and performance monitoring of complex, regulatory\-sensitive loss mitigation programs. The person in this role will participate in the design of challenger (test) strategies including eligibility criteria, opportunity sizing, performance monitoring, and on\-going strategy enhancement. The creation and delivery of presentations to cross functional audiences is essential. In addition, there is on\-going responsibilities for maintaining key performance reporting and strategy documentation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own loss mitigation program reporting and analytics: Create materials and lead monthly presentation to Collections Leadership. Create required quarterly OCC loss mitigation volume and performance presentation slides. Interpret performance and clearly present findings.
* Drive automation and perform ongoing validation/maintenance of new and existing loss mitigation reports; create automated reports with interactive data visualization intelligence.
* Proactively drive visual and content enhancements to loss mitigation program reporting for volumes and performance (e.g. advanced filters for due stage, channel, client, plan type, plan duration etc.).
* Support strategic initiatives by researching industry best practices, analyzing market trends, and identifying opportunities to strengthen pre\-charge\-off loss mitigation efforts.
* Partner with multiple groups to implement reporting changes and assess post\-implementation execution and performance.
* Proactively communicate and engage across multiple levels, on the status of project progress and analytic priorities
* Lead loss mitigation strategy changes for required maintenance (e.g., NCI/NPI; MISC1 changes; regulatory updates). This includes obtaining Working Group and Tollgate approvals, strategy sheet updates, requests to Strategy Delivery, and tracking pre \& post implementation validations (if applicable).
* Support in transitioning all existing and future loss mitigation strategy test performance monitoring to the Growth team
* Provide Analytics support to build best in class strategies for Loss Mitigation programs
* Evaluate new data elements, sources, industry best practices for collections
* Co\-lead or support cross\-functional project teams to consistently track performance. Perform analytics to understand performance changes and make enhancements to address degradation.
* Support OCC, Audit, NMT accuracy requests, regulatory requirements for all loss mitigation programs and ensure strategy documentation is comprehensive, accurate and up to date (i.e., audit ready).
* Participate in ad\-hoc projects and analyses, as needed, Other duties as assigned.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.
* 4\+ years’ experience in SAS, SQL, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, organizational and written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to make decisions and recommendations based on quantitative analysis and creative thinking
* Strong self\-starter balanced with desire to achieve team goals
* Ability to handle sensitive issues with uncompromising integrity and confidentiality


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Prior Collection Strategy Development or Credit Strategy Development/ Risk Management experience and/or prior Collections experience in other functions
* 4\+ years demonstrated success developing and delivering advanced analytics solutions
* Data lake experience and strategies
* Master's degree in Business or in a Quantitative Related Field
* Proven analytical and decision\-making skills
* Experience developing scoring models or decision\-tree segmentations
* Ability to independently manage processes, Self\-motivated, and drive continuous process improvement
* Strong communications, problem solving skills and attention to detail
* Experience presenting to senior leadership teams
* Demonstrated ability to apply strategic thinking toward tactical execution
* Experience working with cross\-functional project teams


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.


**Work Timings:** 
**2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

description:
Established in 2011 and headquartered in Pune, METRO Global Solution Center (GSC) India is a strategic hub driving METRO’s global transformation. With 1,200\+ professionals, we deliver specialized integrated expertise across Master Data Management, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Marketing \& Design, Strategy, Finance \& Accounting, Controlling (FP\&A), and People \& Culture (HR) solutions that drive operational excellence and digital innovation.
   

  

 By supporting METRO’s sCore strategy, we enable sustainable growth and strengthen business processes. With a solutions\-first mindset, we reduce complexity, accelerate transformation, and create measurable value for METRO businesses scaling up globally. METRO is a leading international food wholesaler operating in over 30 countries with a strong network of wholesale stores, digital marketplaces, and food service distribution. It supports businesses that keep the world running, from hotels, restaurants, and cafés to local retailers \- offering quality, reliability, and smart solutions that help small and medium\-sized businesses succeed.
   

  

 Headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany, METRO AG employs over 85,000 people worldwide and acts as the central management holding company of the group, driving strategic direction, and enabling consistent excellence across all markets. Around the world, METRO has approx. 15 million customers who benefit from the wholesale company’s unique multichannel mix: customers can purchase their goods in one of the large stores in their area as well as by delivery (Food Service Distribution, FSD) – all digitally supported and connected. In parallel, METRO MARKETS is being developed as an international online marketplace for professional customers, which has been growing and expanding continuously since 2019\.
   

  

 Acting sustainably is one of the company principles of METRO, which has been listed in various sustainability indices and rankings, including MSCI, Sustainalytics and CDP.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Key Responsibilities

* Full responsibility for departmental P\&L analysis across \~50 departments.
* Conduct weekly and monthly KPI reviews, including margin, supplier income, pricing effects, NWC, stock days, and payment terms.
* Perform in\-depth analyses across supplier, buying category, channel, and customer group dimensions.
* Ensure margin accuracy and alignment with Romanian accounting standards and MCC Romania requirements.

* Lead budget planning and execution for Offer Management department
* Prepare business cases for buying decisions with necessary approvals.
* Support special projects during month\-end (e.g., advance goods loading).

* Work confidently with complex data structures and perform advanced financial analyses.
* Experience with MS Access and Big Data environments would be considered an advantage.


**Cross\-functional Collaboration**
* Collaborate closely with Commercial, Ops, and IT teams.
* Actively participate in transition discussions and retrospectives.


**Language \& Local Knowledge**
* Romanian language proficiency preferred for local reporting and stakeholder engagement.
* Knowledge of the Romanian chart of accounts and local accounting regulations is highly desirable, although not a mandatory hiring requirement.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* University degree in Finance, Accounting, or Controlling.


**Experience**
* Proven experience in budget cycles and controlling.
* Previous experience in retail and stock management environments; experience with Tesco would be considered an advantage.
* Exposure to Romanian accounting systems and post\-LUCA implementation environments.


**Skills**
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and presentation skills.
* Advanced Excel and VBA capabilities.
* Ability to navigate complex metrics and systems.


**Mindset**
* Transition\-oriented, proactive, and detail\-focused.
* Adaptable to evolving systems and able to contribute added value.

title: Data Quality Officer
description:
**About The Role**
**As a
 **Data Quality Officer for HR \& Reference Data** 
 , you will be the key enabler in maximizing the value and trustworthiness of our most critical enterprise domains: our workforce information and core reference datasets.**
**You will act as a proactive partner, collaborating closely with business and technical teams. A critical part of your role is bridging perspectives—from HR business partners to IT architects—into clear, actionable data analysis.**
**Your mission is to resolve data issues and nurture a proactive prevention mindset across the organization. You will translate HR processes and Reference Data requirements into formal data quality policies, rules, and governance standards. By storylining data health metrics and serving as a data provocateur when needed, you will drive the continuous improvement of our core data foundation.**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Domain\-Specific Insight Generation \& Profiling:
+ Perform deep\-dive root cause analysis on HR datasets (e.g., employee lifecycle, payroll interfaces, org structures) and Reference Data (e.g., enterprise code tables, locations, job classifications, cost centers) to isolate systemic, process, or integration issues.
+ Conduct thorough data profiling on critical master and reference datasets to detect anomalies, cross\-system discrepancies, orphan records, and data drift.
+ Document findings and quantify the business impact of poor data quality on operational HR, compliance, reporting, and downstream integrations.

* Stakeholder Collaboration \& Standard Setting:
+ Work closely with HR Data Stewards, Data Governance, and IT to define, document, and enforce clear data quality rules and reference data standards.
+ Translate HR business rules and Reference Data governance policies into precise technical specifications for automated validation and monitoring tools.
+ Act as the primary liaison between business domain owners and technical teams, ensuring alignment on data lineage and data definitions.

* Monitoring, Reporting \& Governance:
+ Maintain domain\-specific Data Quality Dashboards (e.g., tracking HR data completeness, reference data synchronization) for clear visibility across business units.
+ Track and report HR and Reference Data quality KPIs to leadership, driving transparency and accountability.
+ Support reference data management processes, ensuring code values, mappings, and taxonomies remain synchronized across target applications.

* Remediation \& Prevention:
+ Collaborate with IT and HR Tech teams to define requirements for data cleansing, automated enrichment, and exception management.
+ Support business teams at the point of data entry/creation to improve source data quality and minimize manual workarounds.


****Your Profile****
* Boundary Spanner: Ability to connect HR business processes and enterprise reference data structures with backend technical architectures.
* Influencer \& Storyteller: Skilled at translating complex data anomalies into compelling narratives for HR leadership and business managers.
* Collaborator: A strong team player dedicated to building cross\-functional alignment across HR Operations, Enterprise Data Management/Governance, and IT.
* Mindset: Detail\-oriented, persistent, and proactive about driving data transparency and operational excellence.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, HR Analytics, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience as a Data Quality Officer, Data Governance Analyst, or Data Steward, with direct experience handling HR data, Master Data Management (MDM), or Reference Data domains.
* Essential: Strong proficiency in SQL for complex data querying, profiling, and joining datasets across multi\-table environments.
* Hands\-on experience with modern HR Information Systems (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) and Reference Data concepts (code lists, hierarchies, mapping tables).
* Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with global teams.


**Preferred Skills**
* Familiarity with Data Governance frameworks (Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Data Cataloging).
* Experience using scripting languages (e.g., Python) for automated data checks or profiling is a plus.
* Knowledge of global HR data privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, local DPDP regulations).

description:

 TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long\-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.

From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow\-through of an industry leader.
   

  

 We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Data Migration Lead will oversee and execute the migration of geospatial data from legacy systems such as GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri's Utility Network (UN). This role requires expertise in Esri technologies, Utility Network configuration, and data transformation tools like FME. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in utilities (Gas, Electric, Water, Telecom) and experience managing complex data migration projects.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end data migration projects from GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri Utility Network.
* Analyze legacy data models and design migration strategies to align with Esri Utility Network schema and best practices.
* Configure and implement Esri Utility Network models, including network rules, topologies, and asset configurations.
* Develop and execute data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) workflows using FME and Python (ArcPy).
* Perform data quality assessments and validations to ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness during migration.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, define migration objectives, and ensure alignment with business needs.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data compatibility, schema mapping, and network topology during migration.
* Optimize migration processes for performance and scalability, ensuring minimal downtime and data integrity.
* Document migration workflows, methodologies, and lessons learned for future reference.
* Provide training and support to teams on Esri Utility Network and post\-migration processes.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 8\-12 years of experience in GIS, with at least 4\-6 years in data migration projects.
* Strong expertise in Esri technologies, including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, and Utility Network.
* Hands\-on experience with data migration from GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri platforms.
* Proficiency in FME (Feature Manipulation Engine) for data transformation and automation.
* Advanced Python scripting skills (ArcPy) for geoprocessing and data migration tasks.
* In\-depth knowledge of utility network models (Gas, Electric, Water, Telecom) and their operational workflows.
* Experience with spatial databases such as PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills to manage cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Esri Utility Network configuration, including network rules, subnetwork management, and tracing.
* Familiarity with Agile project management methodologies and tools like Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Knowledge of GE Smallworld data structures and migration challenges.
* Experience with large\-scale enterprise GIS implementations and integrations.
* Certification in Esri technologies or FME is a plus.

description:
**Job Summary**
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Vendor Master Sr. Analyst to support end\-to\-end vendor onboarding and vendor master data maintenance across Coupa and SAP. This role is responsible for ensuring accurate vendor creation/updates, completing required due diligence, validating banking details, and maintaining strong controls to mitigate fraud and compliance risk. The ideal candidate has strong stakeholder management skills, excellent attention to detail, and a solid understanding of Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) controls.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Vendor Onboarding (Coupa \& SAP): Manage end\-to\-end vendor onboarding requests including vendor creation, changes, extensions and deactivations in Coupa and SAP (ECC/S4\) in line with defined policies and approval matrices.
* Vendor Onboarding \& Maintenance: Create, update, and inactivate vendor master records per documented procedures; perform duplicate checks, validate required documentation (e.g., tax/legal forms, supplier onboarding forms), and ensure accurate capture of critical data elements.
* Bank Detail Validation / Fraud Prevention: Perform bank account validation and change controls (independent verification callbacks, bank letter/cancelled check review, IBAN/SWIFT validation, 2\-person verification) to mitigate payment diversion risk.
* Document Verification: Review and validate required documents (W\-9/W\-8, VAT/GST certificates, incorporation documents, address proof, remittance details) for completeness, authenticity, and alignment to the vendor request.
* Ticket/Queue Management: Manage vendor master tickets via shared mailbox/workflow tool, prioritize based on business impact and aging, and ensure SLA adherence with timely and professional communication.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Procurement, AP, Tax, Treasury, Legal, and business requestors to resolve data issues, clarify requirements, and drive first\-time\-right submissions.
* Issue Resolution \& Root Cause: Investigate and resolve vendor setup failures, duplicate records, payment blocks, and remittance issues; perform root\-cause analysis and recommend preventive actions.
* Knowledge Management: Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, templates, and training material for vendor onboarding and master data processes; support onboarding of new team members.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Self\-Development: Build expertise in vendor master governance and P2P controls; stay current on Coupa/SAP enhancements and policy updates.
* Process Improvement: Identify recurring defects (duplicates, missing documents, bank change errors), implement standard checklists/automation, and partner with upstream teams to improve submission quality and strengthen preventive controls.


**Skills And Qualifications**
* Experience: 3 to 7\+ years of experience in Vendor Master Data, Vendor Onboarding, AP Master Data, or P2P operations in a shared services/BPO/captive environment.
* Systems: Hands\-on experience with Coupa supplier onboarding and SAP vendor master (ECC and/or S/4HANA). Exposure to ticketing/workflow tools is an advantage.
* Due Diligence \& Documentation: Experience performing vendor due diligence and verifying documents such as tax forms (W\-9/W\-8\), VAT/GST certificates, bank letters, and incorporation/address proofs.
* Data Quality: Strong attention to detail, ability to identify duplicates and inconsistencies, and commitment to first\-time\-right processing in a high\-volume environment.
* Communication: Strong and polished English communication (written and verbal) with proven ability to manage stakeholders and drive timely closures.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze trends, track SLA/aging metrics, and perform root\-cause analysis; good working knowledge of Excel.


**Educational Qualification**
* Graduate/Post Graduate in Finance/Commerce/Business Administration (MBA preferred).
* Certifications or training in SAP/Coupa, KYC/due diligence, or compliance controls are an added advantage.

title: FinOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a FinOps Engineer with a DevOps backbone who has an almost obsessive eye for cost leaks, idle resources, and inefficiencies across our platform. If unused EBS volumes, oversized instances, or a forgotten dev environment running on weekends genuinely bother you, you'll fit right in. This isn't a passive reporting role. You'll be expected to proactively hunt for waste, propose optimisations, and drive strategic cost conversations with engineering, SRE, and leadership across ZOOP's entire platform from infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters to data pipelines and third\-party services.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Continuously audit ZOOP's cloud footprint (AWS/Azure/GCP) end\-to\-end compute, storage, networking, databases, observability stack, and SaaS tooling and flag every form of waste, big or small.
* Proactively propose cost\-reduction strategies rather than waiting to be asked; bring data, options, trade\-offs, and a recommendation to the table.
* Lead monthly/quarterly cost reviews with engineering and product leadership; turn billing data into actionable conversations.
* Build cost visibility dashboards and chargeback/showback models so every team at ZOOP knows what they're spending and why.
* Drive rightsizing, autoscaling tuning, Spot/Reserved Instance/Savings Plan strategies, and storage tiering across the platform.
* Embed cost guardrails into CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation), and Kubernetes manifests to catch wasteful resources before they're deployed.
* Optimise Kubernetes cost efficiency using tools like Kubecost, OpenCost, or Karpenter; tune requests/limits, HPA/VPA, and node pools.
* Set up automated alerts and anomaly detection for budget breaches, idle resources, and runaway costs.
* Partner with Finance for forecasting, unit economics (cost per user/transaction), and cloud budget planning.
* Evangelise a cost\-aware engineering culture, run internal sessions, write playbooks, and make FinOps a shared responsibility, not a finance afterthought.


**Requirements**
* Someone with genuine OCD around cost and wastage; you can't sleep knowing a non\-prod cluster ran all weekend at full capacity.
* A DevOps practitioner first, who understands why costs happen at the infrastructure level, not just someone reading billing reports.
* Naturally proactive; you don't wait for tickets; you spot patterns, dig in, and propose changes before anyone asks.
* Comfortable challenging engineering decisions diplomatically when they're expensive, and equally comfortable defending necessary spend to finance.
* A clear communicator who can talk to both a senior engineer about Karpenter configs and a CFO about quarterly burn.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, SRE, or Cloud FinOps roles.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred), including native cost tools (Cost Explorer, CUR, Azure Cost Management, or GCP Billing).
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi).
* Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE).
* Scripting in Python, Bash, or Go for automation, reporting, and cost tooling.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD).
* Solid grasp of cloud pricing models: On\-Demand, Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, Spot/Preemptible, committed\-use discounts.
* SQL skills for querying billing data (AWS CUR via Athena/Redshift, BigQuery billing exports).


**Nice To Have**
* FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) certification.
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience with FinOps platforms (CloudHealth, Cloudability/Apptio, Spot.io, Vantage, Kubecost).
* Exposure to multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud cost optimisation.
* Understanding of SaaS unit economics (cost per customer, cost per transaction, gross margin impact).


 This job was posted by Malavika Kannoth from ZOOP.

**Who we are looking for**
 Global Delivery Custody is forming a central support team for the Payments, Cash, and Custody (“PCC”) strategic development program. PCC is a multi\-year effort to modernize and simplify State Streets core custody technology platforms. The program is a collaborative approach across Global Delivery, Product, and Technology with integrated planning and decision making. Key outcomes include ensuring STT meets regulatory and market processing requirements, demands of current clients, and creating a world class, competitive Custody product offering The Global Delivery PCC team will work closely with IT and Product to drive the strategy and execution of PCC program components.  As an AVP in t
 **he India PCC program** 
 , you will be responsible for coordination across the different value streams of GD PCC Program activities with specific focus in India. Work with specific project teams \& leads to help coordinate local execution and impact. Function as a point of contact and communication with India leadership related to PCC status and key milestones. Lead strategy and efforts horizontally across value streams to drive consistency and automation for common activities such as project management, business analysis, training, testing, reporting, and Operational readiness. * Experience managing testing phases (UAT / BUAT), migrations, hyper care, and go‑live readiness
* Comfortable working in fast‑paced, change‑driven environments

* Experience using project tracking tools, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms
* Ability to quickly learn and become effective in business applications and platforms relevant to the project (e.g., payments, operations, custody platforms)

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
 Use analytical and quantitative methods to understand, predict, and enhance supply chain processes. Responsible for analyzing performance, identifying problems, and developing recommendations to improve the organization's Supply Chain.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Provide analytical support to one or more functional areas Use common processes tools, and information systems to enable supply chain analysis. Ensure data integrity of all analytics and reports. Analyze and interpret Key Performance Indicators to identify areas for improvement and action plans. Participate in six sigma and supply chain improvement projects Use existing business systems to provide analytics and reporting that are capable and repeatable.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Drives results \- Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
   

  

 Global perspective \- Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
   

  

 Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
   

  

 Optimizes work processes \- Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
   

  

 Materials Planning System Utilization \- Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long\-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day\-to\-day operations.
   

  

 Plan for Every Part (PFEP) \- Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.
   

  

 Analysis and Troubleshooting \- Extracts, transforms, models, interprets, and presents planning data with the goal of mining useful information, troubleshooting, suggesting conclusions, and supporting value creating decision making.
   

  

 Inventory Management and Optimization \- Uses analytics and algorithms to determine the optimal level of inventory investment across the end\-to\-end supply chain within specific constraints (warehouse space, customer delivery, etc.); provides guidance and expertise on planning parameter refinement; develops inventory strategies to support Cummins' strategy and not just a business unit strategy.
   

  

 Material Planning \- Uses advanced tools (e.g. Advanced Planning Command Centre, Business Intelligence (BI) Dashboards etc.) to take a decision related to parts availability, inventory optimization and root cause analysis.
   

  

 Materials KPI Management \- Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end\-customer impact; strategically balances trade\-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent degree required.
   

  

 This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

 Minimal to intermediate level of experience required.

* Strong knowledge of Supply Chain Management concepts
* Hands\-on experience in SQL (intermediate level)
* Proficiency in Power BI (dashboarding, DAX, data modeling)

* Understanding of database systems like Oracle
* Ability to connect and work with multiple data sources
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Good project management \& communication skills to interact with cross\-functional teams

 Candidates with a strong mix of supply chain understanding and data analytics expertise will be preferred.

title: Data Visualization & Reporting Engineer
description:
Job Title
   

  

 Data Visualization \& Reporting Engineer
   

  

**Job Description**
**Data Visualization \& Reporting Engineer\| Pune, India\| Full\-time**
**About Toyota Automated Logistics**
 The TAL Service Analytics team is further evolving towards a full end\-to\-end data analytics center of expertise, within the Service Excellence department and it goal is to deliver standardized, scalable, and business\-driven data products and reporting solutions across the TAL Service organization.
   

  

 Our mission is to enable a data\-driven service organization, where decision\-making is supported by clear, consistent, and actionable insights. This means moving away from fragmented and manual reporting towards standardized KPI frameworks, automated dashboards, and self\-service analytics.
   

  

 To support this ambition, we are looking for a Data Visualization \& Reporting Engineer who combines strong visualization and reporting capabilities with supporting data engineering skills. The role has a clear focus on Qlik dashboarding, reporting usability, and stakeholder value creation, while also contributing to the development and maintenance of data products that ensures high\-quality and trusted reporting solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 You are responsible for refining and maintaining analytical products like dashboards and reports and co\-developing data products and analytical models within the Life Cycle Services domain. In addition, you act as the first point of contact for CDAO and Data Consumers for dashboarding and data issues, query and change requests regarding the business domain data.
   

  

* Design, build, and maintain high\-quality Qlik dashboards tailored to business users across Service
* Translate complex datasets into clear, intuitive visualizations and data stories that drive action and decision\-making
* Define, refine, and standardize KPI frameworks in collaboration with stakeholders
* Improve reporting usability by applying strong data visualization principles, layout standards, and storytelling techniques
* Continuously optimize dashboards for performance, consistency, and business relevance
* Work closely with Business Stakeholders, Product Managers, Data Analysts, and SMEs to translate business questions into concrete dashboards, KPIs, and data products
* Bridge the gap between business and technical teams, as a trusted advisor, challenging requirements and driving clarity in reporting needs, ensuring smooth implementation and adoption
* Contribute to the data and analytics roadmap, aligning new development with the Service priorities


**Key goals \& Tasks FY27**
* Establish a standardized service\-centered reporting framework with clearly defined KPIs and dashboards
* Deliver and maintain scalable analytical data products aligned with the Service roadmap
* Increase dashboard adoption and usage across Service organization
* Reduce manual reporting efforts by automation and standardization of reporting processes
* Strengthen the role of Service Analytics as a data consulting partner within the business
* Identify and deliver high\-value data use cases that directly support business performance improvement


**Key Competences**
* 2–3 years of experience in Data \& Analytics, Data Engineering, or Business Intelligence
* Strong experience or affinity with Qlik (preferred) and/or Power BI dashboarding and reporting
* Strong understanding of data structures, data quality, and potential data issues
* Ability to translate business needs into clear KPIs, dashboards, and actionable insights
* Ability and interest to quickly learn about the business processes in Service in which the data is created and/or used.
* Familiarity with data engineering concepts (data modelling)
* Strong awareness of data consumers and reporting usability
* Strong communication and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to cooperate \& collaborate with team members, Business Stakeholders, Subject Matter Experts and Data Consumers to ensure correct business input as well as successful validation and application of the delivered analytical products
* Ambition to grow into a business\-facing data consultant


**How We Work**
 We work by three values Every day better, We care, and Team play. In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say.
   

  

**Ready to join Toyota Automated Logistics? We look forward to hearing from you!**
 Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 At
 **Toyota Automated Logistics** 
 , you actively shape the future of intelligent intralogistics. As part of Toyota Industries Corporation (TICO), we are a global partner for integrated warehouse automation solutions. Founded in April 2026, we bring together the strengths of Bastian Solutions, viastore, and Vanderlande’s warehousing business under one unified brand.
   

  

 Together, we develop scalable automation systems, intelligent software, and end‑to‑end services across the entire lifecycle for customers around the world. Our ambition is clear to set industry benchmarks and actively shape the future of intralogistics.
   

  

**Diversity \& inclusion**
 At Toyota Automated Logistics, we believe diversity makes us stronger. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

In India, Castrol is a publicly listed company, leading in the Automotive, Industrial, and Marine lubricant sectors. With iconic brands, steadfast innovation, strong customer relationships, and a team of highly motivated employees, we have maintained our market leadership in India for over a century. Our robust manufacturing and distribution network in India helps us reach consumers through more than 135,000 outlets.
   

  

 At Castrol, success knows no bounds. We offer a fast\-paced learning environment where you can develop your career, whether in niche functions or on a general management track. Castrol India has a proud legacy of championing top talent for leadership roles, both locally and globally !!
   

  

**This is a role within the Castrol organization, and the successful candidate will become part of the Castrol ring\-fence. If you are part of the ring\-fence, it is expected that your employment will move with Castrol to new ownership!**

The position drives standardized process \+ data \+ insights outcomes across markets, enabling improved customer service, order reliability, inventory health, and working capital performance. It also ensures robust end\-to\-end supply chain process design, governance, and continuous improvement, with close collaboration across regional process experts, IT, and business teams.

* Ensure alignment of processes with system capabilities and constraints with customers

+ Customer service / order management teams
+ Logistics \& distribution teams

* Regional Ownership \& Working with Customers in regions.

+ Fit\-for\-purpose design aligned with market realities
+ Drive value\-based backlog of change initiatives.

* Drive regional change initiatives, align with global teams, secure funding for change initiatives.
* Responsible for the team's backlog / pipeline of future initiatives, handle the digital funding and Financial Memorandum processes to ensure IT costs are handled and budgeted.
* Drive consistent Agile ways of working through standardized documentation, sprint planning, backlog management, configuration governance, training materials, release management, and continuous improvement delivered via iterative Scrum sprints.
* Promote Continuous Improvement
* Provide thought leadership on use\-cases and modelling approaches
* Sponsor development of decision\-support tools, dashboards, and models
* Govern analytics backlog aligned to business value
* Promote greater end\-to\-end process and system understanding among customers end users.
* Data Analytics \& Supply Chain Insights
* Build \& lead the global analytics operating model
* Lead team of data analysts/engineers/BI developers across Planning, Product Portfolio \& Delivery, Customer Fulfillment, and Process Development.
* Define the analytics service catalog (dashboards, self\-serve datasets, advanced analytics, insights packs) and ensure SLAs, cadence, and quality.
* Establish a scalable governance model (demand intake, prioritization, sprint planning, release management, benefits tracking).
* Deliver global analytics products \& insights, enable, orchestrate multi\-disciplinary Supply Chain insights with the help of advanced analytics, artificial intelligence and machine learning tools.
* Own global data products aligned to supply chain and customer outcomes, e.g.:
+ Order fill \& OTIF (by customer/market/channel)
+ Backorder root\-cause, ATP/CTP insights
+ Inventory visibility (safety stock, slow/obsolete, E2E days of inventory)
+ Demand\-supply match and forecast bias drivers
+ Customer service performance and order reliability
+ Portfolio complexity impact (SKU rationalization, NPI ramp stability)
+ Translate business questions into analytics hypotheses, build models, and convert output into practical actions with decision pathways.

* Drive adoption \& decision impact
* Partner with business process owners and market leaders to embed insights into weekly/monthly operating rhythms (S\&OP, customer service reviews, plant scheduling meetings, supply reviews, procurement and manufacturing).
* Design storytelling and decision\-ready data insights in Power BI (suitable standard stack), including exception\-based analytics and action workflows, health check indicators.
* Data quality, standards, and master data alignment (in partnership with IT/MDM)
* Define critical data elements (CDEs) for end to end supply chain and customer fulfillment analytics.
* Improve data quality via standard definitions, lineage, validation controls, and reconciliation routines.

* Education (University degree or equivalent experience, MBA or equivalent specialization in Supply Chain Management preferred). Supply Planning Accreditation (APICS or similar) preferred. High degree of digital literacy including advanced knowledge of SAP and analytics reporting tools / Power BI etc..


**Experience**
* 12 to 16 years of experience in Order to Delivery, supply chain process areas. Track record of leadership and influencing at senior level. Vast experience of leading change and business transformation within supply chain from gap\-design to go\-live deployment.
* Experience in supply chain/customer analytics and/or SAP process excellence
* Strong functional knowledge of O2D processes and multi\-functional impacts

* Experience working with distributed/global teams, including customer management across time zones.

title: VP - Senior Java Engineer - IB Tech and CRM/ Analytics
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Java Engineer (VP) – IB Tech \& CRM/Analytics \| Pune, India**
**About Jefferies**
 Jefferies is a leading global, full\-service investment banking and capital markets firm. The firm provides a broad range of financial services to institutional investors, corporations, and governments, including investment banking, equities, fixed income, asset management, and wealth management.
   

  

 Headquartered in New York, Jefferies operates in major financial centers across the Americas, Europe, and Asia, with a strong global footprint and deep industry expertise. The firm is known for its client\-centric culture, entrepreneurial mindset, and commitment to delivering innovative, high\-quality solutions across advisory, sales and trading, and research.
   

  

 Technology plays a critical role in Jefferies’ strategy, with ongoing investment in cloud\-native platforms, data engineering, analytics, and modern engineering practices to support business growth, operational excellence, and differentiated client experiences.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an accomplished Senior Java Engineer (VP level) to join the IB Tech \& CRM/Analytics organization. This is a highly strategic, hands\-on engineering leadership role focused on building scalable, cloud\-native, event\-driven platforms that power data\-driven, intelligent solutions across Investment Banking and client\-facing business units.
   

  

 The role combines deep technical expertise, end\-to\-end ownership, and engineering leadership, with close collaboration across business, product, and globally distributed technology teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and delivery of backend services and platform components using Java (8\+) / Spring Boot; Python (FastAPI) exposure is a plus
* Own end\-to\-end solutions — from technical design and architecture through production deployment, monitoring, and support
* Build and operate event\-driven, real\-time data pipelines using Kafka and related streaming technologies
* Drive technical decision\-making for data architecture, including PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redshift
* Design and maintain Java\-based APIs and microservices, including REST, OpenAPI, GraphQL, and gRPC\-based services
* Champion engineering best practices across code quality, testing (unit/integration), CI/CD, and observability
* Mentor and lead junior and mid\-level engineers, setting clear standards through code reviews and technical guidance
* Independently identify, scope, and propose solutions to complex technical problems with minimal direction
* Partner closely with Investment Banking stakeholders, product managers, and cross\-functional technology teams
* Optimize systems for performance, scalability, resiliency, and low\-latency operation
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, contributing to planning, execution, and continuous improvement


**Required Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of hands\-on experience building enterprise\-grade backend systems
* Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices architecture, and distributed systems
* Proven experience with Kafka and event\-driven architectures in high\-throughput environments
* Solid experience with SQL and data modeling, including relational and NoSQL systems
* Hands\-on experience with AWS, containerized deployments (EKS, Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines
* Demonstrated ability to design fault\-tolerant, highly available systems
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders


**Seniority \& Leadership Expectations (VP Level)**
* Independently architects multi\-service, cloud\-native solutions, clearly articulating trade\-offs and design rationale
* Demonstrated track record of leading engineering delivery end\-to\-end
* Proactively identifies performance, scalability, and reliability risks before they impact production
* Sets a strong example for code quality, maintainability, and operational excellence
* Comfortable operating with high ownership and accountability in a fast\-paced environment

title: Marketing Data Analyst
description:

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Funnel \& Performance Analytics
* Analyze the end\-to\-end marketing and sales funnel, including Lead, MQL, SAL/SQL, Opportunity, Pipeline and Revenue stages.
* Identify funnel conversion rates, bottlenecks, leakage, drop\-off points and opportunities for optimization.
* Analyze pipeline velocity, lead quality, campaign contribution and marketing\-sourced / marketing\-influenced pipeline.
* Develop analytical frameworks to evaluate the effectiveness of marketing programs and initiatives.
* Partner with Marketing, Sales and Revenue Operations teams to identify opportunities to improve funnel performance.

* Develop recurring and ad\-hoc reporting for Marketing, Sales and leadership stakeholders.
* Establish consistent definitions and reporting methodologies for key marketing metrics.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency and reconciliation across CRM, marketing automation and BI platforms.
* Turn complex datasets into clear insights, recommendations and actionable business narratives.
* Data Analysis, SQL \& Data Lake Querying
* Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, transform and analyze large datasets.
* Use CQL / data\-lake query languages and related query environments to retrieve and analyze marketing datasets.
* Perform segmentation, cohort analysis, funnel analysis and campaign performance analysis.
* Combine data from multiple martech systems and data sources to create meaningful business insights.
* Investigate data discrepancies, perform root\-cause analysis and work with technical teams to resolve data issues.
* Develop reusable queries, datasets and analytical frameworks to reduce manual reporting effort.
* Salesforce \& Martech Systems
* Work extensively with Salesforce data, including Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Campaigns, Opportunities and related marketing objects.
* Understand CRM data structures, lifecycle stages, campaign membership, lead routing and funnel progression.
* Partner with Marketing Operations and Sales / Revenue Operations teams to improve CRM data quality and reporting.
* Support the design and optimization of marketing processes, workflows and data models.
* Monitor data integrity and identify opportunities to improve CRM governance.
* Marketing Technology \& Automation
* Work with marketing automation and Martech platforms such as Adobe Marketo Engage, Salesforce and other platforms.
* Support integrations and data flows between marketing automation, CRM, enrichment, analytics and other systems.
* Identify repetitive or manual processes and develop scalable automation solutions.
* Collaborate with Marketing Operations and IT / Business Systems teams on system enhancements, integrations and troubleshooting.
* Evaluate new technologies and AI / automation capabilities that can improve marketing efficiency.
* Campaign, Channel \& Market Analytics
* Measure performance across campaigns, programs, events, webinars, digital channels and other marketing initiatives.
* Analyze campaign engagement, conversion, pipeline contribution and ROI.
* Support segmentation and targeting using firmographic, behavioral, engagement and CRM data.
* Develop insights that help Marketing teams optimize audience targeting, campaign execution and investment.
* Data Quality \& Governance
* Monitor and improve data quality across Martech platforms.
* Identify duplicate, incomplete, inconsistent or inaccurate records and develop solutions to address root causes.
* Establish and maintain data definitions, business rules and documentation.
* Partner with stakeholders to ensure consistent lifecycle, campaign, attribution and funnel definitions.
* Cross\-Functional Partnership
* Work closely with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, IT and Data teams.
* Translate business requirements into analytical, technical and operational solutions.
* Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Act as a subject matter expert for marketing data, analytics and reporting.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve marketing processes rather than simply responding to reporting requests.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 4–7 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Analytics, martech Engineering or a related analytical / technical role.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SQL \- mandatory.
* Hands\-on experience with CQL / data\-lake querying \- mandatory.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Salesforce \- mandatory, including understanding of CRM data structures, campaigns, leads, contacts, accounts and opportunities.
* Hands\-on experience with BI / visualization platforms, with strong preference for Tableau and Power BI.
* Strong understanding of B2B marketing and sales funnels, including Lead → MQL → SAL/SQL → Opportunity → Pipeline → Revenue.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to investigate data and identify root causes.
* Ability to translate business questions into data requirements, analysis and actionable recommendations.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills, including advanced formulas, pivot tables and data analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with global stakeholders across different time zones.

title: Data Development Manager

**Job title:** 
 Database Developer
 



  





**Department:** 
 Saisystems Digital (SSD)

 Lead (or) Manager

 2nd Floor, Office No 4, Tara Heights, Mumbai Pune Road, Wakdewadi, Pune, Maharashtra, 411003
 **(no remote/hybrid work)** 




  





**Job overview:** 




 We are seeking a highly skilled Database Developer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in SQL, database design, performance tuning, and ETL development. This role requires expertise in writing complex queries, optimizing database performance, and working with BI tools for data analysis. You will be responsible for ensuring the integrity, performance, and scalability of our databases, as well as managing data migrations, backups, and database administration tasks.
 



  





**Responsibilities \& Duties:** 




  




* Design and implement relational database systems with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Develop normalized data models and build efficient database schemas.
* Write complex SQL queries, including joins, subqueries, and aggregate functions. Optimize queries to improve performance, minimize resource usage, and ensure fast execution times.
* Develop, test, and optimize stored procedures, functions, and triggers to handle complex business logic within the database.
* Implement indexing strategies to optimize query performance and data retrieval. Identify performance bottlenecks and apply optimization techniques for faster query execution.
* Develop and manage ETL processes using tools such as SSIS or Talend, ensuring the smooth extraction, transformation, and loading of data across systems.
* Manage database migration, replication, and integration tasks to ensure data is consistently transferred and maintained across multiple environments.
* Oversee database backup and recovery operations, implement clustering and replication strategies to ensure high availability and disaster recovery.
* Ensure the integrity, consistency, and security of the data through regular checks, validation, and enforcement of best practices.
* Work closely with other developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver optimal database solutions that support business needs.
* Document database structures, processes, and procedures to ensure clarity and consistency. Provide reports on database performance, data integrity, and optimization improvements.
* Stay updated with the latest database technologies and best practices, recommending improvements and new technologies to enhance the database environment.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 




  





**Experience** 
 : Minimum of 5 years of hands\-on experience in database development, SQL, and database administration.
 



  





**Technical Skills** 
 :
 



  




* Expertise in writing SQL queries (including joins, subqueries, and complex operations) and database design, including normalization and ER modeling.
* Strong experience in writing and optimizing stored procedures and functions for complex business logic. Solid understanding of indexing strategies and query optimization techniques.
* Experience with ETL tools such as SSIS or Talend for data migration and integration.
* Experience with database management, backup and recovery, replication, and clustering strategies to ensure high availability and disaster recovery.
* Proficient in analyzing database performance and applying tuning strategies to enhance query execution times and system performance.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one Business Intelligence (BI) tool, such as Power BI, c or similar, to assist with data analysis and reporting.



  





  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 




  




* Familiarity with cloud\-based databases (e.g., Azure SQL Database, AWS RDS) and cloud services related to data management.
* Knowledge of automation tools for database deployment and management.
* Experience in designing and maintaining data warehouses or large\-scale data processing systems.
* Experience with NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra) is a plus.
* Advanced experience with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) for data visualization, reporting, and dashboard creation.



  





**Key Performance Indicators:** 




  




* Efficient, optimized database design and development with high\-performance queries.
* Successful development and management of ETL processes, ensuring smooth data flow between systems.
* High availability of data with minimal downtime through effective backup, recovery, and replication strategies.
* Impactful optimization of database performance, reducing query execution times and improving system responsiveness.
* Clear and consistent communication with stakeholders and developers to meet business and technical requirements.



  





**Competencies:** 




  




* Strong problem\-solving abilities with a keen eye for detail, especially in query optimization and database design.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams, including developers, business analysts, and stakeholders, to meet business needs.
* High level of attention to detail in database design, query writing, and performance optimization.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to adapt to changing technologies, processes, and business needs in a dynamic environment.



  





**Other Requirements:** 




  




* Focus on new development and system improvements, avoiding legacy support or maintenance work.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one BI tool, contributing to data visualization and reporting needs.



  





 This role offers an exciting opportunity to leverage your expertise in database development, performance tuning, and ETL processes while collaborating with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality, data\-driven solutions for business needs. You will be an integral part of a dynamic team, ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of critical database systems.
