Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
   

  

**The Role**
 Addepar has just launched an Alternatives Product offering that gives Addepar clients the option to have their Private Funds data extracted, processed, validated, and ingested directly from Private Fund documents for a more automated end\-to\-end solution for handling Alternatives on the platform. This white\-glove solution combines proprietary machine learning technology that automatically extracts data from Private Funds documents and human\-in\-loop review to validate any documents that fail to pass confidence and data quality checks.
   

  

 As a Senior Lead of the Alternatives Data Operations, you will lead the operations function that is responsible for the human\-in\-loop review of Private Funds documents, ensuring clients' Alternatives data is processed, validated, and available in Addepar in a timely manner. You will manage a team of Alternatives Data Ops analysts who review Private Fund statements, modify data that has been incorrectly extracted by our machine learning models, and reprocess data within SLAs. In this role, you'll own the operational strategy, team performance, and continuous improvement of the Alternatives Data Ops function—a critical component of Addepar's Alternatives offering success.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include building and scaling a high\-performing team, establishing processes and metrics that optimize quality and throughput, managing SLA performance, and serving as the primary liaison between the Alternatives Data Ops team and cross\-functional partners including the Alternatives Product Team, Engineering, Client Delivery, and additional personnel across the organization.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Develop and execute a strategic roadmap for Alternatives and Market data operations, aligning with Addepar's business objectives and corporate growth plans.
* Drive automation and efficiency initiatives, identifying opportunities to reduce manual work, streamline workflows, and scale the team's capacity
* Collaborate with senior leadership to understand the organization's evolving needs and ensure the data operations strategy is closely aligned with these goals.
* Own operational strategy and metrics, establishing KPIs around data quality, processing speed, and client satisfaction—identifying trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement
* Lead issue resolution and escalation, proactively managing blockers and maintaining alignment with internal stakeholders
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Client Solutions to implement new processes and tooling that improve the data processing experience and increase operational efficiency


**Operational Management**
* Oversee the spectrum of operational workflows for alternatives data and market data feeds, ensuring smooth execution and rapid issue resolution.
* Maintain effective process controls to ensure quality standards, and organizational objectives and deliverables are achieved. Establish, monitor, and report on Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for data delivery, ensuring consistent and timely provision of accurate data to internal and external stakeholders.
* Implement robust KPI tracking, metrics and analytics to measure operational effectiveness, resource utilization, operations scalability, and cost\-effectiveness
* Establish and maintain processes, workflows, and playbooks that ensure consistency, quality, and scalability across the Alternatives Data Ops function


**People Management and Culture**
* Lead and grow the Alternatives Data Ops team, including hiring, onboarding, mentoring, and fostering career development—helping team members understand the business impact of their work and creating opportunities for growth within the function
* Mentor managers/leads and consistently promote knowledge sharing and best practices to all groups.
* Manage a global team, fostering a strong culture alongside achieving results: Balance driving performance with cultivating a high\-performing, inclusive, and growth\-oriented team culture. Lead by example, empowering team members to innovate and collaborate effectively, while ensuring accountability for measurable outcomes
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and training of new team members.


**Who You Are**
* 10\+ years of experience in data operations, data management, or a related field within the financial services or wealth tech industry.
* Proven experience in a senior leadership role
* Extensive experience with Alternatives Data (e.g., Private Equity, Hedge Funds, Real Estate, Private Credit) is a must. Experience with Market Data (e.g., equities, fixed income, derivatives, pricing, corporate actions) is a nice to have.
* Proven experience using process automation, operational workflow re\-engineering and continuous improvement to enhance operational efficiency and scalability by using modern tools and technologies.
* Demonstrated track record of improving data quality and operational efficiency.
* Strong project management and analytical skills with experience in leading change management
* Experienced with leading global teams, cross\-functional and cross\-regional projects, and learning and development initiatives.
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging with clients, external data partners, and internal team members and stakeholders.


**Our Values**
* Act Like an Owner \- Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together \- Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients \- Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation \- Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning \- Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


 In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

 PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

title: Manager - Credit Risk
description:
About the Role
 



 We are looking for a Manager – Credit Risk to lead credit risk, underwriting and risk consulting engagements. The role will combine hands\-on credit expertise, client management, solution development and team leadership. The ideal candidate should have strong financial analysis and commercial credit underwriting expertise, sound credit judgment, excellent client communication skills, and the ability to translate client requirements into practical processes and solutions.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Lead delivery of credit risk, underwriting and risk consulting engagements, ensuring quality, timelines and client requirements are met.
* Perform and review financial and credit analysis, including financial statements, ratio analysis, cash flows, liquidity, leverage, profitability, working capital, AR/AP aging and other key credit indicators.
* Monitor credit portfolios and risk trends, identifying emerging risks, changes in financial performance and other indicators requiring attention, and communicate relevant insights to clients.
* Conduct quantitative and qualitative credit assessment, including business model, industry, customer concentration, debt obligations, contracts and supporting documentation, to identify key risks and form a credit view.
* Own client communication and requirement gathering, translating business needs into underwriting frameworks, processes, SOPs and practical risk/technology solutions.
* Manage and develop internal team, including work allocation, quality review, coaching and capability building.
* Drive process improvement, standardization, automation and risk\-monitoring initiatives, and proactively communicate key risks, trends and recommendations to clients.



  





 What we are looking for
 


* 5 years of experience in commercial credit risk, financial analysis or risk consulting, preferably within banking, lending, fintech or financial services; experience with US, Canada or LATAM markets preferred.
* Strong understanding of financial statement analysis, credit appraisal, ratio analysis, cash\-flow and working\-capital assessment, with sound credit judgment.
* Strong credit judgment and attention to detail, including ability to identify financial, operational and qualitative risks from multiple information sources.
* Excellent client\-facing, communication and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to understand ambiguous requirements and develop practical solutions.
* Experience managing/reviewing junior team members and taking ownership of project delivery.
* Experience with process design, SOP development, automation or analytics initiatives.
* Should have strong understanding of Advanced MS Excel and financial analysis/modeling skills.
* Exposure to credit underwriting, financial spreading, banking/transaction data or risk analytics platforms is an advantage.



  





 Educational Qualifications
 


* CA / CA Inter / Semi\-qualified CA preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline.
* Equivalent qualifications with relevant credit risk/underwriting experience may also be considered.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Position** 
 Lead Business Analyst, Billing
 



**Practice** 
 P\&C Insurance
 



**Grade** 
 Lead Consultant, peer level to the existing P\&C Billing Lead Consultant on the account
 



**Reporting** 
 Insurance Practice Head
 



**Location** 
 Offshore delivery center, US Eastern hours overlap
 



**Engagement** 
 Client billing workbench, ground up internal build
 



**Position Summary** 




 Key Management Group is hiring a Lead Business Analyst to own the billing scope on a US P\&C Insurance engagement where the client is building its billing workbench in house. This is a ground up build, not a package implementation. No vendor product supplies default behavior, so the specifications this person writes are the system.
 



 This is a hands\-on functional role, not a coordination role. You will run discovery with the client, define billing behavior from a blank page, write the specifications the offshore development team builds from, drive testing, and be client\-facing every day.
 



 The role sits alongside an existing Billing Lead Consultant on the same team, carrying a similar project scope. We need matching seniority and matching depth. A mid\-level business analyst will not clear this bar, and neither will a senior analyst whose billing career has been spent doing configurations inside a packaged product.
 



**What You Will Own** 



* Run current state discovery with client billing, finance, underwriting and operations teams, then document the AS IS billing process end to end and produce evidence backed gap analysis document
* Write BRDs, FRDs, functional specifications, user stories, use cases and acceptance criteria detailed enough that an offshore developer can build billing behavior that does not yet exist without a follow up call
* Define billing entities, states, transitions, effective dating and audit history precisely enough for the development team to model the data correctly the first time
* Own the billing backlog, size and prioritize it with the client, and keep every scope decision written down and traceable
* Act as the single point of contact between the client and the development team, with daily client contact through the project cycle
* Define every billing integration requirement, covering payment gateways, lockbox and cash files, general ledger posting, commission payables, document generation etc.
* Analyze billing data and write requirements for accounts, open balances, unapplied cash, payment plans and commission history
* Build acceptance criteria for billing scope, run functional and conceptual testing, and lead the QA team through billing regression
* Support client UAT, perform walkthroughs, and manage change requests and version upgrades



**Billing Domain You Must Know Cold** 



* Billing setup at account, policy and payment plan level, including direct bill, agency bill and list bill money flows
* Installment schedules, down payments, service and installment fees, and schedule rewrite after a midterm change
* Invoice generation, invoice timing, billing cycles and statement production
* Cash receipts, payment allocation hierarchy, unapplied and suspense cash, partial payments and reversals
* Commission setup and calculation, splits and overrides, netting, agency payables and statement reconciliation
* Delinquency and dunning, notice of cancellation for nonpayment, cancellation, reinstatement and lapse handling
* Return premium, refunds, write offs, small balance rules and aging
* How endorsement, cancellation and reinstatement transactions hit billed and unbilled premium and earned premium recognition
* General ledger interface, trust versus operating account handling, and month end reconciliation
* Premium finance, mortgagee and escrow billing, and third\-party payer handling



**Required Qualifications** 



* 14\-20 years total professional experience, with a minimum of 12 years as a business analyst in P\&C insurance and a minimum of 8 years spent specifically on billing
* Candidate should be able to describe rules they personally authored
* Able to write a functional specification precise enough to build from, covering states, transitions, calculations, rounding, precision, reversal and audit, with no product manual to lean on
* Deep functional knowledge of at least one enterprise billing processes in core systems such as Vertafore IMS, OneShield OMS, ALIS, Guidewire BillingCenter, Duck Creek Billing or Majesco Billing, held as a reference for how billing should behave rather than as the full extent of the candidate’s experience
* Demonstrated ownership of a billing build, migration or transformation from discovery through go live, as the person accountable for the scope rather than a contributor to someone else’s
* Proven BRD, FRD, user story and use case authorship that distributed development teams have actually built from
* Working knowledge of P\&C underwriting and claims workflows, enough to trace how a policy or claim transaction lands in billing
* Able to run client workshop/walkthrough sessions and hold daily client contact independently, without a delivery manager in the room
* Agile delivery experience with Jira or Azure DevOps and disciplined backlog and traceability hygiene
* Bachelor’s degree required, with commerce, finance or accounting preferred

description:

title: Data Intelligence Manager
description:
**Who We’re Looking For**
 Fieldwire is looking for a Data Intelligence Manager to join our Data \& Operations team based in Pune, India. You will be the operational owner of reporting and analytics for a core business function (G\&A, R\&D, or GTM), turning raw data into accurate, timely, and trusted intelligence that drive decisions at the executive and departmental level. You will work closely with our Data Engineers, DIM Team Lead, and business partners to build dashboards, define KPIs, and maintain rigorous data quality. This role is critical to the integrity and scalability of our reporting landscape.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
**The primary responsibilities for this role include:**
* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of non\-native dashboards for your assigned business function (G\&A, R\&D, or GTM), combining data across multiple source systems into a single, accurate view
* Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards and BI products (Power BI or equivalent), ensuring they are always live, accurate, and clearly documented
* Define and govern KPIs and performance metrics for your business area, ensuring consistent definitions across teams and regions
* Act as the primary business partner for stakeholders in your assigned function — translating business questions into analytical requirements and delivering clear, decision\-ready intelligence
* Conduct extensive QA on all data outputs: validate inputs, test transformations, reconcile outputs against source systems, and prevent conflicting or duplicate reporting
* Maintain a single source of truth for your reporting area, ensuring consistency across all dashboards and outputs
* Manage a release and change control process for dashboard updates — including testing, versioning, and stakeholder communication before any changes go live
* Monitor data quality continuously; detect and escalate anomalies, breaks, or integrity issues early
* Document all metrics, logic, and definitions clearly so that any stakeholder can understand what the data means and how it is calculated
* Contribute to cross\-training within the DIM team to ensure coverage and reduce single points of failure
* Support the DIM Team Lead and Director of Operations in roadmap planning and continuous improvement of the reporting landscape


**At Fieldwire, we’re looking for our next Data Intelligence Manager to have the following skills and experiences:**
* 3\-5 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or data intelligence role
* Strong proficiency in SQL and hands\-on experience building dashboards in Power BI
* Experience working with large datasets across multiple systems and understanding how to combine them into coherent reporting
* Demonstrated ability to conduct rigorous QA on data outputs and maintain high standards of accuracy
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills — able to identify inconsistencies and root\-cause data issues independently
* Experience defining and governing KPIs and metrics frameworks
* Excellent communication skills — able to present complex data findings clearly to non\-technical business stakeholders
* Familiarity with ETL/ELT concepts and how data pipelines work upstream of analytics
* Detail\-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Comfortable working across time zones in a globally distributed team


**And if you have any of the following, we** 
**REALLY** 
**want you to apply today!**
* Experience in a SaaS or technology company, ideally with exposure to GTM, Finance, or R\&D data
* Familiarity with Salesforce reporting and data structures
* Experience working with dbt, Snowflake, or similar modern data stack components
* Exposure to data governance frameworks and metric catalogues
* Prior experience supporting executive\-level reporting or board\-level dashboards
* Background in construction technology or field operations analytics is a plus


**Why Fieldwire?**
 The field\-first construction platform for less busywork and more building. Trusted on 4M\+ projects worldwide, Fieldwire by Hilti gives crews reliable access to plans, tasks, and updates on one simple platform. It unites the field and office around a single, transparent source of truth, keeping teams aligned from start to finish. Designed for easy adoption, crews gain real\-time visibility into progress, clear ownership of work, and the context to make confident decisions. As part of the Hilti Group, Fieldwire combines deep construction expertise with modern digital innovation to deliver better outcomes on every job. Learn more at Fieldwire.com.
   

  

**Where is the job located?**
 This role is hybrid in Pune, India.
   

  

*Monday \& Friday: WFH 2:00 PM–10:00 PM IST to align with our global team's operating hours.*
*Tuesday\-Thursday \- 12:00 PM–8:00 PM IST to align with our global team's operating hours.*

title: Data Quality Analyst - Senior 2
description:
**Job Summary**
 Leads, develops, and implements project(s) of varying complexity and size in assigned functional area. Partners with business stakeholders to ensure a successful project completion and organizational improved capability to data quality standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Leads the quality and integrity of the data within the assigned functional area. Serves as an expert on data quality tools. Conducts data profiling for data. Develops Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure data quality. Creates and executes action plans to resolve data quality issues. Maintains existing rules and develops new rules to support a robust data quality process. Escalates issues and critical conflicts in a timely fashion. Identifies and mitigates data quality risks. Reports data quality risks and KPI measurement statistics to data governance council. Manages metadata and data standards to ensure adherence, working closely with IT. Coordinates activities of data stewards located within the business, working closely with the business process owner. Supports business data analysis and proposal creation as a member of a data governance council. Guides the business to prepare data. Leads initial data exploration steps (binning, pivoting, summarizing and finding correlations, for example). Catalogues business attributes to enable data discovery. Coaches business to establish and enforce guidelines for data collection, integration and processes. Leads data and systems analysis as required to support data governance processes. Understands data governance roles and processes, and ensures that they are followed. Prepares and presents communications to leaders and stakeholders.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Balances stakeholders \- Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.
   

  

 Collaborates \- Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
   

  

 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.
   

  

 Interpersonal savvy \- Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people.
   

  

 Manages ambiguity \- Operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
   

  

 Data Analytics \- Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.
   

  

 Data Mining \- Extracts insights from data by identifying relationships and patterns through use of a suite of data exploration and data visualization techniques to understand the underlying structure of the data and enable sound conclusions upon model building.
   

  

 Data Modeling \- Creates, writes and tests data models, test scripts and build scripts using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Data Communication and Visualization \- Constructs a tale of the business problem, root cause, solution options, and opportunities through illustrating data visually, including reports and dashboards.
   

  

 Data Governance \- Assures definition, ownership, metadata management, and security for Cummins data.
   

  

 Data Literacy \- Expresses data in context, including data sources and constructs, analytical methods and applied techniques; describes the use\-case application and resulting value.
   

  

 Data Profiling \- Assesses data issues and cleansing requirements to perform data extraction, mapping, collection, and testing; establishes good, quality data.
   

  

 Data Quality \- Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent degree in statistics, information systems or related field required.
   

  

 This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

**Experience**
 Intermediate level of relevant work experience required.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities Unique To The Role**
* Lead the design, implementation, and continuous evolution of the Enterprise Data Quality Framework across the data ecosystem(ingestion pipelines, data warehouses, semantic layers, and Data Products). Establish scalable standards, policies, controls, and best practices that ensure enterprise data is trusted, governed, certified, and AI\-ready. 2\) Establish and operationalize data quality capabilities by implementing automated data profiling, validation, reconciliation, monitoring, observability, issue management, and scorecard processes. Define measurable data quality KPIs, SLAs, and governance mechanisms that improve the accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, validity, and reliability of critical enterprise data assets. 3\) Partner with Data Engineering, Solution Engineering, Enterprise Data Management (EDM), Architecture, Product Management, cross functional teams and Business teams to embed Data\-as\-a\-Product quality practices throughout the data lifecycle, including business rule management, metadata standards, lineage validation, certification processes, root cause analysis, and proactive remediation of data quality issues.


**Required Skills, Education, Or Experience**
* Strong hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and leading enterprise Data Quality programs and frameworks, including data profiling, validation, reconciliation, root cause analysis, monitoring, issue management, scorecards, and continuous improvement initiatives across large\-scale Data Warehouse, Lakehouse, and Data Product environments. 2\) Strong expertise in Data Quality, Data Governance, Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Data Stewardship, Master Data Management (MDM), Business Glossary Management, and Data\-as\-a\-Product practices, with experience establishing quality standards, controls, certification processes, and governance frameworks for enterprise data assets. 3\) Proven experience implementing and automating data quality controls across the end\-to\-end data lifecycle, including Source Systems, Data Ingestion, Raw/Bronze, Curated/Silver, Business/Gold, Semantic Models, and Enterprise Data Products, utilizing capabilities such as data profiling, rule\-based validations, reconciliations, anomaly detection, exception management, data observability, and quality KPI monitoring. 4\) Hands\-on expertise with modern cloud data platforms and data engineering technologies, such as Snowflake, Databricks, SQL, Matillion, dbt, and Power BI, with the ability to design scalable data quality solutions and embed quality controls within enterprise data pipelines. 5\) Experience with enterprise Data Quality and Governance platforms, and data observability solutions to implement data quality frameworks, metadata management, lineage, cataloging, certification, and governance capabilities across enterprise data products.


**Preferred (Nice To Have) Skills, Education, Or Experience**
* Experience implementing data quality frameworks for Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Lifecycle, and other Enterprise Products domains within large\-scale Data Modernization or Data\-as\-a\-Product initiatives. 2\) Experience applying AI/ML and Data Observability capabilities to Data Quality, including anomaly detection, predictive quality monitoring, automated root cause analysis, AI\-ready data certification, and governance controls supporting Analytics, Machine Learning, and GenAI solutions.


 Education
   

  

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
   

  

**Job** 
 Quality
   

  

**Organization** 
 Cummins Inc.
   

  

**Role Category** 
 On\-site with Flexibility
   

  

**Job Type** 
 Exempt \- Experienced
   

  

**ReqID** 
 2435195
   

  

**Relocation Package** 
 No
   

  

**100% On\-Site**

 As part of the Quantitative Banking Book (QBB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk management within the banking portfolio. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk estimation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with lending activities. * Good to have knowledge in Machine Learning models and its applications
* Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have.
* Previous project management experience

* Regulatory knowledge in IFRS 9, IRB, CCAR, CECL, Stress Testing, DFAST

* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and support engagements with global financial institutions

description:
Red Nucleus is hiring a Associate/Sr. Associate Consultant \- Epidemiology \& Outcomes Research to join our global team. This role will be remote.
   

  

 Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives. We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services, and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry. Our global team is composed of nearly 800 full\-time employees whose commitment to creativity, quality, and on\-time delivery is unrivaled in our space.
   

  

 At Red Nucleus, we believe in providing a rich working environment that pushes us to innovate in ways that engages our employees to be their best selves. Our culture is about meaningful work, a true sense of community, and fun. We love to celebrate our people and we are proud to have been Internationally recognized as a “Great Place to Work".
   

  

**Job Overview**
 The Associate / Sr. Associate Consultant is a core member of the Epidemiology \& Outcomes Research team, responsible for supporting health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), evidence generation, and evidence synthesis projects across a range of therapeutic areas.
   

  

 This role requires strong analytical and epidemiological skills, along with the ability to independently manage multiple concurrent projects under the guidance of a senior team member. You will contribute to the design and execution of literature reviews and other secondary research, interpret complex clinical, epidemiological, economic, and health outcomes evidence, and supervise junior colleagues on select workstreams.
   

  

 The role requires close collaboration with cross\-functional project teams and direct engagement with clients during meetings, project discussions, and deliverable presentations.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

 Research and Analysis
   

  

* Support the design and execution of systematic literature reviews (SLRs), targeted literature reviews (TLRs), and other evidence reviews, including development of search strategies, screening criteria, data extraction frameworks, and evidence synthesis approaches
* Conduct structured searches across bibliographic databases and other relevant evidence sources; screen literature against project\-specific inclusion/exclusion criteria and supervise junior colleagues on the same
* Extract data in a structured manner, perform in\-depth quality control, critically appraise studies, and interpret clinical, epidemiological, economic, and health outcomes evidence
* Resolve complex data issues, identify key evidence gaps and insights, and summarize scientific data clearly and accurately
* Support qualitative and narrative evidence synthesis across projects, including areas such as burden of disease, treatment patterns, unmet need, clinical outcomes, and other health outcomes evidence

title: Business Data Modeler
description:
Job Title
   

  

 Business Data Modeler
   

  

**Job Description**
**Your responsibilities**
 As a Business Data Modeler, you play an important role in creating a shared understanding of Vanderlande's business processes, information, and terminology. You translate business needs and domain knowledge into clear business object models and business data models that support consistent decision\-making and collaboration across the organization.
   

  

 Your primary focus is understanding how business domains operate and identifying the key business concepts, relationships, and information flows that underpin them. In this role, you act as a bridge between business and IT, helping stakeholders develop a common view of the business and its information.
   

  

 You work closely with business stakeholders, data stewards, domain experts, architects, and analysts to capture, structure, and document business knowledge in a way that is understandable, reusable, and future\-proof.
   

  

**In this role, you**
* Engage with business stakeholders, data stewards to create a shared understanding of business processes, objectives, terminology, and information needs.
* Analyse business processes and identify key business concepts, objects, and relationships.
* Translate business knowledge into clear business object models and business data models.
* Improve the quality, usability, and adoption of the business data model.
* Document and maintain business definitions, relationships, and modeling standards.
* Collaborate with architects, analysts, and ICT colleagues to ensure business concepts are consistently represented across processes and systems.
* Support data governance by promoting consistent business definitions, data ownership, and shared understanding of information.
* Promote the use and value of business modeling across the organization and contribute to the continuous improvement of modeling practices.


**Your Skills \& Competencies**
 We are looking for an enthusiastic, curious, and business\-oriented professional who enjoys understanding how businesses operate and who can translate complex information into clear and structured models.
   

  

**You bring**
* A bachelor’s degree in information management, Business Administration, Business Information Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 10\+ years of experience working with business processes, data analytics, information management or business analysis.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand and structure complex business processes and information.
* Understanding of data governance, business glossaries, data ownership, data quality, master data, or business architecture concepts.
* The ability to identify patterns, relationships, and concepts across processes and organizational boundaries.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders from different backgrounds.
* The ability to facilitate discussions, ask the right questions, and challenge assumptions constructively.
* A structured and detail\-oriented way of working.
* A proactive attitude and eagerness to learn.


**Nice to have**
* Experience with business analysis, information analysis, process modeling, or business object modeling.
* Familiarity with modeling techniques such as UML or BPMN.
* Awareness of Data Products, Data Mesh, or domain\-oriented data ownership.
* Experience working in a complex, international organization.
* Familiarity with Agile ways of working.
* Basic SQL knowledge is beneficial, but not mandatory.


**Diversity \& inclusion**
 Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

 We are seeking an experienced Principal Database Refactoring \& Performance Architect with 10 to 15 years of expertise in Oracle database modernization, performance engineering, and cloud\-enabled data transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep knowledge of Oracle 19c, advanced SQL and PL/SQL optimization, Azure\-based data solutions, and enterprise\-scale database architecture.

* Rewrite and optimize complex SQL queries using Oracle 19c Cost\-Based Optimizer (CBO) best practices.

* Lead schema redesign initiatives, including normalization, denormalization, and optimization of large\-scale enterprise databases.

* Optimize Azure\-hosted applications and services interacting with Oracle databases through enhanced connection pooling, batch processing, and integration patterns.
* Design scalable data integration frameworks leveraging Azure Data Factory and cloud\-native technologies.
* Improve database availability, scalability, reliability, and disaster recovery capabilities.

* 10 to 15 years of experience in Oracle Database Administration, Architecture, Performance Engineering, and Database Modernization.
* Expert\-level knowledge of Oracle PL/SQL, Advanced SQL, Query Optimization, and Database Refactoring.
* Extensive experience with Oracle Database 19c and Autonomous Database environments.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Cost\-Based Optimizer (CBO), Adaptive Query Optimization, and SQL Plan Management.
* Proven expertise in execution plan analysis, performance diagnostics, and database tuning methodologies.
* Hands\-on experience with BULK COLLECT, FORALL, Collection Types, Object Types, and Analytical Functions.

* Experience designing highly available, scalable, and resilient database architectures.
* Strong expertise in partitioning, indexing strategies, data modeling, and schema optimization.

* Knowledge of hybrid cloud architectures and database migration strategies.
* Experience implementing monitoring, observability, logging, and performance management frameworks.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data architecture and governance principles.
* Ability to identify and remediate technical debt within large\-scale database ecosystems.

title: Cyber Risk Governance & Reporting
description:
Join us as a Cyber Risk Governance \& Reporting at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Cyber Risk Governance \& Reporting, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Managing a large and complex portfolio of cyber risk governance, regulatory assurance, and reporting activities across regions, entities, and stakeholders
* Performing data analysis and preparing responses to support Barclays’ continued compliance with regulatory obligations across the globe
* Strong working knowledge of cyber security, risk management, and regulatory expectations, with the ability to translate complex technical content into clear, non\-technical outputs for senior stakeholders and regulators
* Using collaboration, workflow, and reporting platforms such as SharePoint, trackers, and MI dashboards to generate insights, support decision\-making, monitor delivery, and highlight emerging risks
* Supporting tracking, oversight, and resolution of control issues, including those raised by 2LOD and internal assessments that could impact regulatory compliance
* Driving group\-wide GRC assessments, reporting, and compliance to the Barclays Control Framework to identify control enhancements aligned to regulatory requirements
* Enabling proactive risk identification through thematic analysis, MI\-driven insights, continuous improvement initiatives, and effective stakeholder engagement


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Strong experience in Governance, Risk \& Control within large enterprises, preferably within financial services or a similarly regulated environment
* Ability to generate, analyse, and interpret cyber security MI using qualitative and quantitative techniques to identify trends, risks, control gaps, and improvement opportunities
* Experience with audit oversight, control frameworks, internal assessment activities, and regulatory requirements, including the ability to support evidence\-based assurance and issue remediation
* Ability to translate technical cyber risks into business\-relevant insights, reporting narratives, and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively across cyber, technology, risk, compliance, audit, and senior leadership teams.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, and communication, as well as job\-specific technical skills in cyber risk governance, regulatory engagement, reporting, and quality assurance.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune, India.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To provide independent and balanced advice and counsel to senior stakeholders through problem identification, solving and decision making practices.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Provision of strategic advice to Group Executives to support the decision\-making process of business challenges and opportunities.
* Development and implementation of strategic advisory incentives to grow and optimise the bank’s operations, through market research and analysis.
* Collaboration with various stakeholder groups to identify the appropriate strategic direction type to meet the needs of Barclays clients and investors.
* Development of financial models to support strategic recommendations and transactions through financial data analysis, financial projects and considering the financial impact of transactions.
* Management of transactions, negotiations, transaction structure development and post\-transaction integration.
* Collaboration with internal stakeholders to maintain client relationships, and develop new relationships to identify opportunities.
* Identification of industry trends, maintain peer benchmarking and developments related to strategic advisory services by attendings conferences, participating in training and conducting market research.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Project Sr Analyst - C12 - PUNE
description:
Organization Overview:
   

  

 We are a dynamic, global, and diverse Organization, with a presence in over 60 Countries; covering all front post execution Operations teams including product aligned Middle Office groups, Settlements, Margin, Asset Servicing, Listed Derivative \& Commodities Operations. We support an extensive range of Capital Markets products and services including Fixed Income (FX, Rates, Credit, Muni, Cash and Derivatives) where Citi is consistently a dominant top 3 player in the market, Equity (Cash, Derivatives, Prime Brokerage, Futures, Listed Derivatives, FXPB) where Citi has a significant growth program to continue to build out its capabilities and services; and Syndicates where we support both FI and EQ new issues and IPOs.
   

  

 We take pride and are passionate about our People and our culture. We are invested in our People and their development. We are transforming and simplifying our operating model, creating an exciting environment which encourages diversity of thought and inclusion.
   

  

 Our Operations groups are core to the success of the Markets business and have significant impact across the lifecycle of a trade. We partner extensively with a range of internal stakeholders including Front Office Sales and Trading Desks, Compliance, Legal, Finance and HR; alongside having significant interaction with our external client base, playing a key role in the overall client experience. We have a Client relationship group, dedicated to overseeing the Organizational service performance and strategic partnership for our top tier client base, where we play a key role in supporting our global clients to ensure they have a first\-class experience when doing business with Citi.
   

  

 Our Business Intelligence and Process Re\-engineering group works alongside our Operations teams delivering automation solutions to solve for operational challenges. We partner with Citi’s innovation labs to drive optimization, and overall play a pivotal role in enabling us to transform to achieve our target operating model.
   

  

 Our Technology partners develop and implement a wide range of applications that support the Operations, Change, Design and Implementation groups in providing innovative products and solutions. We have re\-imagined how to provide technology and service in our domain through the alignment of our team vision, culture, and aggressive retirement plan for legacy applications and adoption of a micro\-based containerized cloud environment. We encourage our people to create, explore and be adventurous whilst taking measured risk, adopting safe practices to protect the firm. Data lineage and optimization is core to how we develop our eco system. We are growing our capabilities using artificial intelligence, natural language processing and machine learning.
   

  

 Our roles entail ensuring we operate in a robust control environment, whilst in a fast\-paced workplace. We comply with global regulations and internal policies and adopt a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to reduce risk through the continuous evaluation of our controls; to protect our clients, the firm, and our reputation.
   

  

 We work closely with our external global peers, partners, and regulators, and play an integral part in leading an agenda at the forefront to optimize and streamline processes and drive strategy across our industry.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 The Markets Process Engineering team has been formed to support stakeholders both within Operations and across the bank, to design and deliver a multi\-year transformation roadmap. Our transformation is underpinned by strategy, investment change execution and a market leading change delivery team focusing on program and project management, business analysis, process re\-engineering and low code application development.
   

  

 The Futures and OTC Clearing franchise is an agency business providing trading and clearing capabilities across 40\+ exchanges to our clients and proprietary lines of business such as Equities, Rates, Commodities, FX and Prime D1\. The business is embarking on a strategic re\-engineering of its platforms. This is a multi\-year initiative, moving to real\-time computation, and with ambitious goals to design and deliver a more robust, strategic, well controlled end state for Futures and OTC Clearing Operations.
   

  

 We are recruiting for a Project/Business Analyst to help lead the delivery of strategic initiatives. This is a great opportunity to join a growing, global, and dynamic change management team, delivering a major Tier 1 program.
   

  

 The role will work in partnership with the Futures and OTC clearing business, global operations teams, technology and downstream areas such as finance and regulatory reporting.
   

  

 The core responsibilities of the Project Manager and Business Analyst include but not limited to the following:
   

  

* Develop and manage project plans, define project scope, goals, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements to ensure successful project execution.
* Manage project lifecycle from initiation to closure, ensuring that project deliverables are met and proper evidence provided.
* Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies, developing and implementing effective mitigation and contingency plans.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including project charters, requirements, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Facilitate and lead project meetings, including kick\-offs, status updates, working groups and governance forums, to ensure clear and consistent communication among all project participants.
* Conduct business and data analysis to document business and operational processes and recommend improvements.
* Develop and maintain detailed process maps, use cases to support business and functional requirements
* Analyze existing business processes to identify opportunities for improvement, and assist in designing enhanced workflows
* Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure that developed solutions meet business requirements and are fit for purpose.
* Prepare senior level presentations to communicate project updates
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance and other functions to ensure successful project implementation.


**Qualifications:**
* Project Management and Business Analysis experience
* Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) Regulatory Reporting knowledge is a plus
* 2\-3 years operations experience (preferably in banking)
* Critical thinking and problem solving
* Strong ability in use of Microsoft Applications (PowerPoint, Visio, Project, Word, Excel, Access)
* Proficient with the project life cycle (Waterfall \& Agile)
* CAPM, PMP, PgMP and/or MBA are a plus
* Developed communication and diplomacy skills required to persuade and influence others; may negotiate with external parties.


**Role Overview:**
 The role we are recruiting for is a hybrid Business Analyst / Project Manager role aligned to the Equities business. You will be part of the Futures \& Derivatives Clearing (FDC) and Equities Operations Program Execution Team, a key component of the Markets Ops Transformation organization. The team drives strategic transformation and delivers Target Operating Models for FDC and Equities Operations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Project Leadership \& Delivery: Manage end\-to\-end projects from defining scope, milestones and deliverables with stakeholders to ensuring successful, on\-time delivery meeting business needs.
* Planning \& Documentation: Develop comprehensive project documentation, including charters, business requirements, plans, and risk/issue logs.
* Monitoring \& Reporting: Monitor project progress, resources, and risks, identifying and escalating issues promptly and providing timely, clear updates and presentations to all stakeholders, including senior management.
* Process Optimization: Lead business analysis efforts, clarify requirements, and drive the development and implementation of innovative, efficient processes for Equities Operations.
* Risk \& Compliance: Apply robust risk management practices and ensure regulatory compliance to protect the firm's reputation.
* Team \& Collaboration: Drive resource planning and foster strong cross\-functional collaboration across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and other departments.
* Strategic Initiatives: Champion change management and undertake additional strategic projects/tasks as required.

description:

**Description**
**Mission Statement \- BizTech that delivers WOW**
 As a BizTech team we are passionate about our Twinings and Ovaltine brands and we strive to WOW our customers, consumers, suppliers and colleagues.
   

  

 We are proud to be leaders in technology who partner and drive change across our business. This change does not happen in a vacuum, and we support our aspiration with behaviors that embody the ways of working by
 ***being curious***
 to grow ourselves and look to continuously improve coupled with a
 ***build trust***
 mindset. We are excited about the journey ahead and would love you to be part of creating a digital future for TwiningsOvo.
   

  

**Purpose**
 The Data Architect strengthens the impact of, and provides recommendations on, business information that will need to be available and shared consistently across the organization through the identification, definition, and analysis of how information assets aid strategies and business outcomes. The Data Solutions Architect is responsible for discovering the data and analytics requirements for information for all uses and will be accountable for designing and evolving our data solutions, helping us provide a strong technical foundation as well as set of organisational practices for our journey to be a data driven organisation.
   

  

 The D\&A Architect will work closely with our internal teams as well as SI and partner teams on design, estimation and build phases of various initiatives, including Program Optimus to ensure Reporting requirements are captured
   

  

**Scope**
 This role will cover all regional business functions across TwiningsOvo businesses.
   

  

 The role will be based in India, with occasional international travel to other TwiningsOvo offices, including France, Switzerland, Thailand, China, Australia, UK and USA.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Own the blueprint for Twining’s Data \& Analytics Platform and Data Management solutions that enable the complete spectrum of analytics – from classic BI to advanced analytics (ML/AI) based use cases.
* Influence Information Strategy by partnering with leadership teams in business units and leadership teams to provide strategic recommendations to maximize the value of information assets via their creation, access and use.
* Co\-ordinate with ABF/Twinings Security and Compliance teams to ensure new or existing solutions of new and existing solutions.
* Create and own architecture diagrams for cloud based solutions that conform to best practices and the ability to transform this down to implementation phases to be handed over to Engineering teams.
* For both local and global initiatives, provide architectural support to ensure solutions conform to our Global D\&A strategy, with a roadmap and plan that allows us to move from current state to the future state as well as end state
* Support and influence local initiatives with a view of global alignment on technology and delivery.
* Partner with IT Teams globally to understand information challenges across ERP and other systems and own the delivery strategy across all source systems, internal and external.
* Co\-own our charter for being a data\-driven organisation, focussing on delivering technical solutions that drive adoption and self service, creating an empowered user base.
* Build an understanding of future needs, direction, ambition and risks for each BU and functional area and communicate with technical teams to own platform/solution architecture.
* Participate in sprint planning sessions with the project team, aligning dependencies, highlighting risks and estimating efforts.
* Build and maintain an understanding of the analytics technology landscape, researching emerging trends and how to exploit for our business benefit and value.
* Co\-create compelling business cases by:


* Building an understanding of Twinings Ovo value drivers to clearly articulate benefits for projects.
* Helping business partners communicate the solution value to key stakeholders.


* Prototype and co\-design for innovative data \& analytics solutions. Evaluate tools \& tech to enhance platform and solutions.
* Participate in Technology supplier/product vendor sourcing selection activities (RFx processes), and commercial negotiations / supplier onboarding processes (define/refine criteria’s to be considered)
* Support the analysis and evaluation of possible impact of changes to the existing application landscape and organisation and plan mitigation actions.
* Support and actively engage in end to end delivery of Analytics projects from design, build, test and deployment, and transition into BAU support.
* Support test activities by ensuring acceptance criteria are well documented and have the appropriate level of coverage, taking responsibility for the design and execution of test cases where appropriate.
* Work with the wider project teams to enable the solutions to be imbedded within the business through the development of communications and training materials.
* Ensure that all working practices comply with Health and Safety legislation and Twinings policies
* Act as a role model for Twinings Ovo values (champion of BizTech culture, nurture and develop capabilities (Business and Technical)).


**Key Responsibilities**
* Minimum 12 years’ experience in architecting D\&A solutions with a focus on owning the technical framework for the end to end landscape.
* Background in analytics, and familiarity with how analytics/data\-driven organisations embed data as a first class citizen. Deep understanding of the D\&A technology space with a focus on SaaS/Cloud products.
* Problem solving skills, including being able to bring expertise in structured analysis and design and programming skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including influencing skills.
* Able to build strong relationships with key stakeholders in order to truly understand the underlying needs of the business.
* Ability to influence decision making, comfortable with challenging and being challenged.
* Experience of working with teams in multiple locations, and remotely
* Effective conceptualization and pattern recognition skills.
* CPG industry experience
* Experience of working in a fast\-paced international business, comfortable with change and ambiguity. Able to deliver change to the business.
* Thirst for knowledge, questions, seeks to understand and continues to learn. Excited by and keeps up to date with latest Technology developments. Proactively looking outside and proposing ideas
* A self\-manager and motivator, able to prioritise and recognise when ownership and escalation appropriate
* Ability to work in a matrix organisation
* Awareness of Cyber Security and Information Security


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Cloud Environments** 
* Azure experience preferred. Experience of implementing solutions in cloud environments using native/3rd party tools is preferred, including building continuous ingestion and hybrid data lake/warehouse solutions with full auditability and traceability. Understanding of Serverless and SaaS products offered, their strengths and appropriate use cases.
* Azure certifications are beneficial.


**DWH Tools** 
* Snowflake or experience of similar analytics focussed tools like Synapse, Vertica, DB Delta lake etc. Deep understanding of parallel processing methodologies including MPP and shared nothing architectures.
* Knowledge of SAP Analytics technologies (SAP BW/4, SAP Analytics on Cloud) etc. are a plus.


**ETL** 
* Experience with Talend or other GUI based ETL tools, including best practices for performance, monitoring and error logging.
* Experience with implementing hybrid solutions of above with Big data technologies like Spark/DataBricks etc.


**Data Modelling \& Data Lake** 
* Expertise with designing Analytical data models based on requirements. Proficiency in resolving modelling issues like double counting, dimension\-dimension relationships etc.
* Expertise in implementing a tiered data lake with different consumption layers.
* Understanding of various file formats relevant in Data lakes and expertise of creating recommendations based on use case and persona.
* Experience of modelling optimized dataflows in BW/4, including integration patterns with non SAP technologies


**Business Intelligence** 
* PowerBI or equivalent. Experience designing self service models in BI tools that are refreshed and monitored in an automated manner.
* SAP Analytics on Cloud is a plus


**Programming Language** 
* Not compulsory but any Python/Scala (Data Engineering focussed) experience, including modules like Pandas, Numpy, Keras etc. is a plus

Your work will influence how ideas become features, how features become products, and how products deliver meaningful outcomes in a fast paced, evolving environment.
   

  

 As a key member of the Product team, you will play a hands on role in defining business requirements, crafting user stories, and ensuring that technical execution aligns seamlessly with business objectives. You will lead user acceptance testing (UAT), drive iterative testing cycles, validate enhancements, and ensure that issues or defects are accurately identified, tracked, and resolved. Your keen eye for detail and strong communication skills will help ensure that every release meets the highest standards of quality and functionality.
   

  

 This is a client facing and user centric role where you will engage with stakeholders, address queries, clarify requirements, and ensure that feedback is incorporated into continuous product improvements. You’ll gain a deep understanding of real world user behaviors, business processes, and product journeys—making this the perfect place to grow as a product focused business professional while driving meaningful impact across the product lifecycle.
   

  

 If you’re energized by the opportunity to influence product development end to end, collaborate with cross functional teams, and help bring scalable, user friendly solutions to life, this role provides the platform for you to make a lasting difference.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, ensuring alignment across stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams.

* Review and validate bug fixes, ensuring that resolved issues meet expected outcomes before closure.
* Engage with clients and end users, addressing queries, troubleshooting issues, and gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
* Support product rollout activities, including release planning, communication, and training support where required.
* Monitor product performance post release, identify enhancement opportunities, and contribute to backlog prioritization.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation including requirement specifications, UAT plans, test results, and user feedback logs.
* Support product strategy, roadmap planning, and end\-to\-end product lifecycle management for Internal Controls and Audit solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders across business, risk, audit, and technology teams to gather requirements and drive product adoption.
* Own MIS, reporting, KPI tracking, and executive dashboards to measure product performance and business outcomes.
* Analyse large datasets to derive insights, identify control gaps, and support decision\-making.
* Drive product implementation, rollout, user onboarding, and change management initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define functional requirements and prioritise product backlogs.
* Identify automation and AI opportunities to enhance audit and internal control processes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Risk Assessment – Assessment of internal processes to identify findings, vulnerabilities, and control gaps/deviations identified across applications and infrastructure.
* Control Monitoring / Testing \- Understanding of controls around Business processes, ITGC, Cyber, Data protection and privacy to perform testing of design and operational effectiveness of controls.
* Ability to create process documentation.
* Ability to understand business problems in Risk/Finance and contribute to translating them into solution or product requirements.
* Exposure (through projects or roles) to Risk, Finance, Supply Chain Operations (SCO), or related business functions preferred.
* Demonstrates interest in AI/analytics\-driven Risk solutions and their business applications.
* Agentic AI architecture\- Design agentic AI system architectures and define associated technical guardrails.
* Functional understanding of foundation models (LLMs) and associated risks. Awareness of the AI deployment lifecycle
* Control Automation – Identify automation opportunities using analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
* Basic exposure to Presales, solutioning, proposal support, or client presentations is a plus.
* Interest in working in tech\-enabled or AI\-led Risk products/solutions environment.
* Ability to support senior team members in product development, go\-to\-market efforts, and client engagements.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, global delivery environment with distributed teams.
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.
* Open to hiring across locations, aligned with EY’s Global Delivery Services (GDS) model.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* CA or Master’s degree in Business Administration or Risk management
* Good to have certifications – CISA, CISM, CIA, AIGP, ISO 42001, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant)
* Any 1 hard tech skill is a must – Either Python or Databricks Or full stack or AI

* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Experience in reporting, MIS, analytics, and data\-driven decision making.
* Hands\-on experience in product implementation and deployment.
* Domain expertise in Internal Controls, Risk, Compliance, or Audit (mandatory).


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 250\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

**EY \| Building a better working world**

description:
**About The Job**

* Opportunity to lead the transition from reactive reporting to predictive ecosystem intelligence.

 of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably within a software or technology environment.

title: Data Analyst - Senior
description:
As a Senior Data Analyst, measurement, you will be the analytical engine behind our commercial performance tracking. Serving within the Global Verticals Marketing team, you will act as the primary point of contact for querying, analysing, and synthesizing FedEx internal transactional and customer data. Your mission is to convert complex datasets into clear, actionable vertical performance narratives that guide business planning.
   

  

 In this role, you will build executive\-ready reports, conduct ad\-hoc analyses, and provide data\-driven insights that directly support marketing, commercial strategy, and forecasting functions. Your work will directly influence how senior leadership understands vertical health, product performance, and regional business dynamics.
   

  

**Grade : T5**
**"Please note that the Job will close at 12am on Posting Close date, so please submit your application prior to the Close Date"**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Vertical Performance
   

  

* Write, optimize, and execute complex SQL queries against FedEx enterprise data warehouses to extract performance metrics across priority industry verticals (e.g., E\-commerce, Healthcare, Aerospace, Technology).
* Monitor and analyse key commercial indicators, including volume, revenue, and yield, with a specific focus on identifying regional / lane / product level insights.
* Investigate regional and product\-level performance variations, isolating root causes of growth or decline and translating findings into structured data briefs.
* Build, maintain, and automate interactive performance dashboards and scorecards to track commercial performance, vertical health, and pipeline health.


 Executive \& Leadership Reporting
   

  

* Synthesize complex performance datasets into high\-impact, visual, and narrative\-driven reports for leadership and executive\-level business updates (e.g., CEO updates and strategic reviews).
* Translate analytical findings into concise executive takeaways, ensuring executive communications clearly explain the past performance, present status, and future outlook.
* Deliver regular monthly and quarterly performance updates, highlighting competitive risks, commercial opportunities, and customer journey trends.


 Strategic \& Forecasting Support
   

  

* Partner with forecasting, strategy, finance, and marketing functions to model commercial funnels, market demand shifts, and historical volume trends.
* Apply statistical techniques and behavioural segmentation models to track, isolate, and forecast changes in specific customer cohorts and industry verticals.
* Conduct rapid\-response, ad\-hoc deep dives to answer critical, time\-sensitive business questions posed by leadership.
* Provide data backing and baseline historical trends to support annual commercial strategic planning and commercial goal setting.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

 Experience \& Background
   

  

* 6\-10 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, sales analytics, or financial/commercial measurement roles.
* Proven experience querying large\-scale, complex relational databases to extract commercial, transactional, and customer\-level insights.
* Demonstrated track record of preparing executive\-calibre presentations, briefs, and reports based on complex data analysis.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional, global stakeholders across various time zones.

title: Assoc Logistics Analyst
description:
At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.
   

  

**About The Role**
 A Day in the Life
   

  

 Our Global Diabetes Capability Center in Pune is expanding to serve more people living with diabetes globally. Our state\-of\-the\-art facility is dedicated to transforming diabetes management through innovative solutions and Technologies that reduce the burden of living with diabetes.
   

  

 This position is an exciting opportunity to work with Minimed’s Diabetes business. Medtronic has announced its intention to separate the Diabetes division to promote future growth and innovation within the business and reallocate investments and resources across Medtronic, subject to applicable information and consultation requirements. This separation provides our team with a bold opportunity to unleash our potential, enabling us to operate with greater speed and agility. As a separate entity, we anticipate leveraging increased investments to drive meaningful innovation and enhance our impact on patient care.
   

  

 \#BetterDaysStartNow
   

  

 Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
   

  

* Controls the flow of raw and finished goods, services, and information between point of origin through receipt at the manufacturing site, through to customer placement in order to meet customer or manufacturing requirements.
* Ensures the execution and continuous improvement of logistics processes, such as the replenishment system, data interchange systems, demand management, electronic data systems administration, and related functions.
* Ensures that customer service and time objectives are achieved within existing financial constraints in order to meet marketing and financial objectives.
* Builds relationships with manufacturing, suppliers, and customers through the resolution of delivery issues.
* Integrates market intelligence from operating entities, distribution, transportation, suppliers, and customers to continuously improve competitive position.
* Abilities and Skills: Analytical, Project Management, Operational Excellence, Data Analytics, Business Acumen, Learning Agility, Influencing/Negotiation, Cross\-level Collaboration and Communication.


**Key Responsibilities \& Requirements**
* Gather and analyze business requirements from warehouse, logistics, shipping, and distribution stakeholders to support SAP\-based process improvements.
* Perform Fit\-Gap Analysis by evaluating current warehouse operations against SAP best practices to enhance inventory accuracy, warehouse efficiency, and order fulfillment processes.
* Configure, support, and maintain SAP logistics modules including: SAP EWM SAP WM SAP Inventory Management SAP TM
* Support warehouse operations including inbound/outbound processing, picking, packing, putaway, replenishment, cycle counting, and shipping activities.
* Utilize Winshuttle and LSMW for data migration, mass uploads, and SAP process automation activities.
* Manage and maintain logistics master data including material masters, storage bins, handling units, batch management, and warehouse organizational structures.
* Develop custom SAP reports, KPIs, dashboards, and analytics using: Microsoft Power BI Microsoft Excel SAP reporting and query tools
* Conduct data validation, cleansing, and harmonization to ensure accuracy and integrity across warehouse and logistics systems.
* Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), System Integration Testing (SIT), and defect resolution activities for SAP enhancements and implementations on business side
* Create and maintain functional specifications, process documentation and SOPs
* Train end\-users and provide post\-go\-live production support for SAP warehouse and distribution functionalities.
* Collaborate with supply chain, procurement, transportation, warehouse operations, and IT teams to optimize logistics performance and warehouse throughput.
* Support SAP implementation, migration, upgrade, and enhancement projects while minimizing operational disruption.
* Identify warehouse process bottlenecks and recommend automation and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Assist with inventory reconciliation, stock movement analysis, and root cause analysis for warehouse discrepancies.
* Utilize SQL queries and SAP data extraction techniques to analyze logistics performance trends and support operational reporting.
* Monitor KPIs including inventory accuracy, order cycle time, picking accuracy, warehouse utilization, and on\-time shipment performance.
* Support change management initiatives and ensure compliance with operational standards, audit controls, and warehouse procedures.
* SAP Master Data Warehouse, Logistics and Distribution, Warehouse management, SAP system, basic medical drives , pharma, industry not needed, warehouse prospective.

 N / A – job at this level is focused on self\-development.

 High School Diploma, Vocational diploma, or equivalent with 2\+ years of relevant experience in Supply Chain Logistics (or equivalent experience) OR Associate's Degree with 1\+ year experience OR Baccalaureate Degree with 0\+ years experience.
